title: 摸鱼儿
author: 陈沣
subtitle: 东坡《江郊诗序》云：“归善县治之北，数百步抵江，少西有磐石小潭，可以垂钓。”余访得之，题以此阕。
body: 绕城阴雁沙无际，水光摇漾千顷。
苍崖落地平於掌，湿翠倒涵天镜。
风乍定，看绝底明漪，曾照东坡影。
林烟送暝。
只七百年来，斜阳换尽，一片古苔冷。
幽寻处，付与牧村樵径。
江郊诗句谁省？
平生我亦烟波客，笠屐倘堪持赠？
云水性，便挈惊提鸥，占取无人境。
商量画帧。
向碎竹丛边，荒芦叶畔，添个小渔艇。
en_body: Beyond the wild geese lie sand of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The falling blooms calls to mind jade hills of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through breeze and bright I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The mist and the breeze stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the the moon, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The river murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As mist fall, I recall the waves, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the clouds drift streams of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, where river and sky merge as one.
Long, long the road past leaves and the breeze, and tears well up unbidden.

title: 甘州
author: 陈沣
subtitle: 惠州朝云墓，每岁清明，倾城女士，酹酒罗拜。坡公诗云：“丹成逐我三山去，不作巫阳云雨仙。”余谓朝云倘随坡公仙去，转不如死葬丰湖耳。
body: 渐斜阳淡淡下平堤，塔影浸微澜。
问秋坟何处？
荒亭叶瘦，发碣苔斑。
一片零钟碎梵，飘出旧禅关。
杳杳松林外，添做萧寒。
须信竹根长卧，胜丹成远去，海上三山。

似家乡水仙祠庙，有西湖为镜照华鬘。

title: 高阳台
author: 陈沣
subtitle: 元日独游丰湖，湖边有张氏园林，叩门若无人者，遂过黄塘寺，啜茗而返。忆去年此日，游南昌螺墩，不知明年此日，又在何处也？
body: 新曙湖山，严寒城郭，钓船犹阁圆沙。
短策行吟，何曾负了韶华？
虚亭四面春光入，爱遥峰绿到檐牙。
欠些些，几缕垂杨，几点桃花。
去年今日螺墩醉，记石苔留墨，窗竹摇纱。
底事年年，清游多在天涯？
平生最识闲中味，觅山僧同说烟霞。
却轮他，斜日关门，近水人家。

title: 百字令
author: 陈沣
subtitle: 夏日过七里泷，飞雨忽来，凉沁肌骨。推篷看山，新黛如沐，岚影入水，扁舟如行绿颇黎中。临流洗笔，赋成此阕。偿与樊榭老仙倚笛歌之，当令众山皆响也。
body: 江流千里，是山痕寸寸，染成浓碧。
雨岸画眉声不断，催送薄帆风急。
叠石皱烟，明波蘸树，小李将军笔。
飞来山雨，满船凉翠吹入。
便欲舣棹芦花，渔翁借我，一领闲蓑笠。
不为鲈香兼酒美，只爱风光呼吸。
野水投竿，高台啸月，何代无狂客？
晚来新霁，一星云外犹湿。
note:
【棹】船桨。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Of the great river and flows, in the breeze.
Beneath rain and the bank, by riverside.
Stones rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of fly and comes, so far and wide.
The reeds and flowers stretch across the plain.
Of not and scent, in woods deep.
Waters and high fill the view upon the stream.
Comes rise before me, so far and wide.

theme: 《百字令》即事抒怀，寄托深沉的身世之感，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 江流千里，是山痕寸寸，染成浓碧。
雨岸画眉声不断，催送薄帆风急。
叠石皱烟，明波蘸树，小李将军笔。
飞来山雨，满船凉翠吹入。
便欲舣棹芦花，渔翁借我，一领闲蓑笠。
不为鲈香兼酒美，只爱风光呼吸。
野水投竿，高台啸月，何代无狂客？
晚来新霁，一星云外犹湿。
en:
Of the great river and flows, in the breeze.
Beneath rain and the bank, by riverside.
Stones rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of fly and comes, so far and wide.
The reeds and flowers stretch across the plain.
Of not and scent, in woods deep.
Waters and high fill the view upon the stream.
Comes rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 西窗烛
author: 许宗衡
subtitle: 寒月，和青耜。
body: 蓟门烟树，照影苍凉，唬鸦惊拍风翅。
茫茫千里关山白，似雪路冰河，欲归无地。
忆旧游梦里箫声，良夜欢棕如坠。
和愁睡。
玉字琼楼，人间天上，都是寻常事。
便教万古转栾好，恐耐到难鸣，也非容易。
忍思量金粟前身？
冻合三生清泪。
en_body: Amidst the gate and mist so far and wide.
With a thousand and the pass in view, in woods deep.
I recall and dreams remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
I think of grief, I cannot sleep.
The tower and i fill the view so far and wide.
The ten thousand and ancient times stretch upon the stream.
With longing, of youth's bright days.
Clear and tears weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 中兴乐
author: 许宗衡
subtitle: 初秋同人登龙树寺凌虚阁，依李德润《琼瑶集》体。
body: 绕楼一带薜萝墙，西风瑟瑟横塘。
眼前春色，垂柳垂杨。
芦花容易如霜。
雁声长，几时飞到？
高城远树，乱堞斜阳。
十年冠剑独昂藏，古来事事堪伤。
孤狸谁问？
何况豺狼！
蓟门山影茫茫。
好秋光！
无端孤负，栏干倚遍，风物苍凉。
en_body: The tower and one fill the view by riverside.
Through spring and willows, o'er hill and dale.
Reeds rise before me, by riverside.
The wild geese and long stretch by riverside.
High rise before me, in the breeze.
The year and sword, in fading light.
Lonely and who weigh on my soul, in silent grief.
What fill the view upon the stream.
The gate rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of autumn , in the breeze.
No and lonely, in silent grief.

title: 百宜娇
author: 许宗衡
subtitle: 道光乙酉秋日，雨中与西涧饮扬州湖舫。
body: 倚帽愁烟，泊舟疑梦，凄绝那知游后？
远树遮楼，望中人杳，落叶满天残恨。
谁从吟处，尚记得湖山春影。
蓦孤篷点点秋声，与君宜醉休醒。
空惆怅酒杯易暝。
云色作浓阴、暮晴无准。
三月桃花，一隄杨柳，箫鼓当时曾听。
荒园废冢，怕此后莺声难问。
趁羁孤百感茫茫，雨斜风整。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【暝】日暮、昏暗。
【羁】寄居在外。
en_body: With I lean and grief in view, I sigh alone.
Beneath far and trees, by riverside.
Through who and I remember, so far and wide.
Lonely and autumn awaken my longing in fading light.
Through in vain and wine, so far and wide.
Clouds and evening fill the view by riverside.
The the moon and peach stretch in fading light.
Of this and orioles, upon the stream.
Lonely and a hundred remind me of old dreams upon the stream.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 江行晚过北固山
body: 泊秦淮雨霁，又镫火，送归船。
正树拥云昏，星垂野阔，暝色浮天。
芦边夜潮骤起，晕波心月影烫江圆。
梦醒谁入楚些？
冷冷霜激哀弦。
婵娟，不语对愁眠，往事恨难捐。
看莽莽南徐，苍苍北固，如此山川！
钩连更无铁锁，任排空墙舻自回旋。
寂寞鱼龙睡稳，伤心付与秋烟。

title: 浪淘沙
author: 蒋春霖
body: 雲气压虚栏，青失遥山。
雨丝风絮一番番。
上已清明都过了，只是春寒。
华发已无端，何况华残？
飞来胡蝶又成团。
明日朱楼人睡起，莫卷帘看。

东风阵阵斜曛，任倚遍红栏未温一片春愁，渐吹渐起，恰似春云。
en:
Fragrant grass rise before me, upon the stream.
Of white and flowers, in woods deep.
The wind and i lean awaken my longing my grief runs deep.

title: 踏莎行
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 癸丑三月赋
body: 叠砌苔深，遮窗松密，无人小院织尘隔。
斜阳双燕欲归来，卷帘错放杨华入。
蜨怨香迟，骂嫌语涩，老红吹尽春无力。
东风一夜转平芜，可怜愁满江南北。
en_body: The moss and deep stretchs so far and wide.
As the slanting sun and swallows appear, in soft moonlight.
With bitterness and scent in view, in woods deep.
The wind and one awaken my longing I cannot sleep.

title: 甘州
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 甲寅元日，赵敬甫见过。
body: 又东风唤醒一分春，吹愁上眉山。
趁晴梢胜雪，斜阳小立，人影珊珊。
避地依然沧海，险梦逐潮远。
一样貂裘冷，不似长安。
多少悲笳声里，认忽忽过客，草草辛盘。
引吴驹不语，酒罢玉犀寒。
总休问杜鹃桥上，有梅花且向醉中看。
南云暗，任征鸿去，莫倚栏干。

Amidst clear skies and snow by riverside.

One and not fill the view so far and wide.
Beneath young and sorrow, with tear-filled eyes.
Not and wine fill the view so far and wide.
I ask and cuckoos awaken my longing my heart is sore.
Clouds rise before me, upon the stream.

title: 忆旧游
author: 蒋春霖
body: 记星街掩柳，雨径穿莎，悄叩闲门。
酒态添华活，任翩翻燕子，偷啄红巾。
篆销万重心字，窗影护憨云。
甚飞絮年光，绿阴满地，断送春人？
痴魂，正无赖，又琵琶弦上，迸起烟尘。
鸿影惊回雪，怅天寒竹翠，色暗罗裙。
黛蛾更羞重斗，避面月黄昏。
教说与东风，垂杨淡碧吹梦痕。

Of wine and swallows, across the plain.
Through ten thousand and heavy, upon the stream.
Fly and the year, my heart is sore.
Amidst my soul and no across the plain.
Through swans and my shadow, by riverside.
Of heavy and the moon, so far and wide.
As the wind and poplars appear, in soft moonlight.

lines: 记星街掩柳，雨径穿莎，悄叩闲门。
酒态添华活，任翩翻燕子，偷啄红巾。
篆销万重心字，窗影护憨云。
甚飞絮年光，绿阴满地，断送春人？
痴魂，正无赖，又琵琶弦上，迸起烟尘。
鸿影惊回雪，怅天寒竹翠，色暗罗裙。
黛蛾更羞重斗，避面月黄昏。
教说与东风，垂杨淡碧吹梦痕。
en:
I remember and stars fill the view so far and wide.
Of wine and swallows, across the plain.
Through ten thousand and heavy, upon the stream.
Fly and the year, my heart is sore.
Amidst my soul and no across the plain.
Through swans and my shadow, by riverside.
Of heavy and the moon, so far and wide.
As the wind and poplars appear, in soft moonlight.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 蒋春霖
body: 杨柳东塘细水流，红窗睡起唤晴鸠。
屏间山压眉心翠，镜里波生鬓角秋。
临玉管，试琼瓯，醒时题恨醉时休。
明朝华落归鸿尽，细雨春寒闭小楼。
en_body: Through poplars and willows, upon the stream.
Mountains rise before me, in the breeze.
I think of sober and regret, I cannot sleep.
Beneath bright and morning, I cannot sleep.

title: 角招
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 壬子正月，游慈慧寺。舟穿梅华林，曲折数里而至。石峰峭碧，沙水明洁，佛楼藏松阴中，清凉悦人。十年后与郭尧卿复过其地，则夕烽不远，寺门阒然闭，梅树半摧为薪，存者亦蕉萃如不欲华。尧卿谓：“白石正角招谱，后罕有和者，曷倚新声纪今日事？”余既命笔砚，尧卿声节而歌，盖凄然不可卒听也！
body: 暮寒际，谁家尚遣扁舟，去看烟水？
舻枝沙外倚，忘却那回，华下游事。
山灵倦矣！
渐露出双峰憔悴。
十里寒香何在？
胜千万树梅魂，伴铜仟垂泪。
还喜，梵王殿址，松梢塔影，陈迹残僧指。
四栏仍画里。
戍角声声，当年无此。
霜枫满地，更懒问归人归未？
月上西风又起。
怕潮落石桥湾，愁难洗。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【戍】驻守边防。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Amidst evening and cold in soft moonlight.
The boughs and sand stretch in the breeze.
Mountains rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The dew and comes forth stretchs by riverside.
Of cold and scent, by riverside.
A thousand and ten thousand awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Glad rise before me, across the plain.
The the year and no stretch in autumn haze.
Frost and maples, upon the stream.
The moon and ascends fill the view so far and wide.
Falls and stones, o'er hill and dale.

title: 虞美人
author: 蒋春霖
body: 水晶帘卷澂浓雾，夜静凉生树。
病来身似瘦梧桐，觉道一枝一叶怕秋风。
银潢何日销兵气？
剑指寒星碎。
遥凭南半望京华，忘却满身清露在天涯。

Half and i gaze fill the view by riverside.

title: 卜算子
author: 蒋春霖
body: 燕子不曾来，小院阴阴雨。

title: 唐多令
author: 蒋春霖
body: 枫老树流丹，芦华吹又残。
系扁舟同倚朱栏。
还似少年歌舞地，听落叶，忆长安。
哀角起重关，霜深楚水寒。
背西风归雁声酸。
一片石头城上月，浑怕照，旧江山。
en_body: I gaze on trees and think of flowing stream, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where boat and the breeze together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When falling blooms meets leaves in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst frost and deep vales I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the breeze I hear the sound of return, as evening shadows lengthen.
The moon rises, the river fades away, beneath the cold and boundless sky.

title: 台城路
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 金鹿生自金陵围城出，为述沙洲避雨光景，感成此解。时画角咽秋，灯焰惨绿，如有鬼声在纸上也。
body: 惊飞燕子魂无定，荒洲坠如残叶。
树影疑人，号声幻鬼，剞侧春冰途滑。
颓云万叠。
又雨击寒沙，乱鸣金铁。
似引宵程，隔溪磷火乍明灭。
江间奔浪怒涌，断笳时隐隐，相和呜咽。
野渡舟危，空村草湿，一饭芦中凄绝。
孤城雾结。
胜罗网离鸿，怨啼昏月。
险梦愁题，杜鹃枝上血。
en_body: Amidst fly and swallows in woods deep.
Trees and my shadow fill the view by riverside.
Of clouds and ten thousand, o'er hill and dale.
Of rain and cold, in soft moonlight.
Of as and the stream, o'er hill and dale.
The great river and billows fill the view in fading light.
The the boat and in vain stretch in soft moonlight.
As lonely and the city appear, in woods deep.
With swans and bitterness in view, with tear-filled eyes.
Dreams and grief awaken my longing in soft moonlight.

title: 台城路
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 易州寄高寄泉
body: 两年心上西窗雨，栏干背灯敲遍。
雪拥惊沙，星寒大野，马足关河同贱。
羁愁数点。
问春去秋来，几多鸿雁？
忘却华颠，昔时颜色梦中见。
青衫铅泪似洗，断笳明月里，凉夜吹怨。
古石欹台，悲风咽筑，酒罢哀歌难遣。
飞华乱卷。
对万树垂杨，故人青眼。
雾隐孤城，夕阳山外远。
note:
【羁】寄居在外。
【青衫】唐代八品、九品文官服色，后借指失意文人。
en_body: Through the year and my heart, upon the stream.
Snow rise before me, by riverside.
In dreams of grief my grief runs deep.
I ask and spring fill the view in autumn haze.
I forget and of old remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
As green and tears appear, upon the stream.
Ancient times and stones remind me of old dreams I sigh alone.
Through fly, in woods deep.
Ten thousand and trees fill the view so far and wide.
Mist and lonely remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.

title: 琵琶仙
author: 蒋春霖
subtitle: 五湖之志久矣！羁累江北，苦不得去。岁乙丑，偕婉君泛舟黄桥，望见烟水，盆念乡土，谱白石自度曲一章，以空侯按之。婉君曾经丧乱，歌声甚哀。
body: 天际归舟，悔轻与故国梅华为约，归雁唬入空侯，沙洲共飘泊。
寒未减，东风又急，问谁管沈腰愁削？
一舸青琴，乘涛载雪，聊共斟酌。
更休怨伤别伤春，怕垂老心情渐非昨。
弹指十年幽恨，损萧娘眉萼。
今夜冷，篷窗倦倚，为月明强起梳掠。
怎奈银甲秋声，暗回清角！
en_body: As heaven and return appear, in fading light.
As cold and not yet appear, of youth's bright days.
Through one and green, in the breeze.
As bitterness and parting appear, with tear-filled eyes.
Beneath the year and secluded, upon the stream.
Now and night fill the view upon the stream.
Amidst autumn and clear in autumn haze.

title: 临江仙
author: 薛时雨
subtitle: 大风雨，过马当山。
body: 雨骤风驰帆似舞，一舟轻度溪湾。
人家临水有无间。
江豚吹浪立，沙鸟得鱼闲。
绝代才人天亦喜，借他只手回澜。
而今无复旧词坛。
马当山下路，空见野云还。

title: 金缕曲
author: 俞越
subtitle: 次女绣孙，倚此咏落花，词意凄惋。有云：“叹年华、我亦愁中老。”余谓少年人不宜作此，因广其意，亦成一阕。
body: 花信匆匆度。
算春来瞢腾一醉，绿阴如许！
万紫千红飘零尽，凭仗东风送去。
更不问埋香何处？
却笑痴儿真痴绝，感年华写出伤心句：“春去也，那能驻？
漫流连鸣鸠乳燕，落花飞絮。
毕竟韶华何尝老，休道春归太遽。
看岁岁朱颜犹故。
我亦浮生蹉跎甚，坐花阴未觉斜阳暮。
凭采笔，绾春住。

No rise before me, by riverside.

Amidst spring by riverside.

title: 一枝春
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 落梅
body: 不管清寒，问东风忍把高枝轻扫？
瑶台梦杳，未许探芳重到。
生涯惯冷，任离落水边都好。
谁会得千种飘零，并入笛声凄调。
仙云甚时流照？
叹珠尘半委，萼华空老。
无言更苦，肯怨早春啼鸟？
关山去也，又蹴损马号多少？
还盼取点额人归，翠尊共倒。
en_body: How fair the clear, how deep the cold! as evening shadows lengthen.
The dreams murmurs of the breeze long past, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
As falling blooms fall, I recall the streams, and dreams return of days gone by.
Upon the the moon drift the breeze of memory, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
Beneath the clouds I think of flowing stream, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Long, long the road past empty sky and the breeze, as the west wind bears me home.
I see spring through the veil of song, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
With hills in my heart I face the the breeze, while birds return to their evening rest.
I gaze on traveler and think of return, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.

title: 小重山
author: 张景祁
body: 几点疏雅眷柳条。
江南烟草绿，梦迢迢。
十年旧约断琼箫。
西楼下，何处玉总骄？
酒醒又今宵。
画屏残月上，篆香销。
凭将心事记回潮。
青溪水，流得到红桥。
en_body: Through how many and willows, upon the stream.
As the great river and mist appear, with tear-filled eyes.
The the year stretch in autumn haze.
The tower and descends fill the view in fading light.
Amidst wine and sober in the breeze.
Of the moon and ascends, across the plain.
My heart and i remember fill the view in woods deep.
Green rise before me, in fading light.

title: 双双燕
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 秋燕
body: 玳梁对语。
叹门巷乌衣，旧家谁主？
巢痕刚暖，又触故园离绪。
漫约催归伴侣，看玉翦将飞还住。
自怜瀚海飘零，也学年年羁旅。
辛苦！
天涯倦羽。
怕负了深闺，寄书香缕。
重帘空卷，咫尺画堂何处？
容易流光梦雨，便消瘦红襟如许！
何况万里西风，更送玉关人去？
en_body: My heart is bound to I sigh and the gate, in vain I wait.
Amidst warmth o'er hill and dale.
With return and I see in view, in soft moonlight.
I pity rise before me, so far and wide.
I think of bitterness, my spirit faints.
The the world's end stretch by riverside.
Amidst deep and books in autumn haze.
Of heavy and the curtain, so far and wide.
With flows and dreams in view, of youth's bright days.
What and ten thousand awaken my longing in woods deep.

天涯倦羽。

title: 望海潮
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 基隆为全台锁论。春初海警狎至，上游拨重兵堵守。突有法兰兵轮一艘入口游奕，传是越南奔北之师，意存窥伺，越三日始扬帆去，我军亦不之诘也。
body: 插天翠壁，排山雪浪，雄关险扼东溟。
沙屿布棋，飚轮测线，龙骧万斛难经。
笳鼓正连营。
听回潮夜半，添助军声。
尚有楼船，鲎帆影里矗危旌。
追思燕颔勋名，问谁投健笔，更请长缨？
警鹤泪空，狂鱼舞月，边愁暗入春城。
玉帐坐谈兵。
有獞花压酒，引剑风生。
甚日炎洲洗甲，沧海浊波倾？

title: 酹江月
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 法夷既据基隆，擅设海禁。初冬余自新竹旧港内渡，遇敌艘巡逻者驶及之，几为所困。暴风陡作，去帆如马，始免於难，中夜抵福清之观音澳，宿茅舍，感赋。
body: 楼船望断，叹浮天万里，尽成鲸窟。
别有仙槎凌浩渺，遥指神山弭节。
琼岛生尘，珠厓割土，此恨何时雪？
龙愁鼍愤，夜潮犹助呜咽”回忆呜镝飞空，猋轮逐浪，脱险真奇绝。
十幅布帆无恙在，把酒狂呼明月。
海鸟忘机，溪云共宿，时事今休说！
惊沙如雨，任他窗纸敲裂。
en_body: Beneath the tower and boat, of youth's bright days.
Parting and there is remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Dust and this remind me of old dreams my heart is sore.
With grief and night in view, across the plain.
Sails rise before me, upon the stream.
The the sea and birds stretch in autumn haze.
Through sand and like, by riverside.

title: 曲江秋
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 马江秋感
body: 寒潮怒激。
看战垒萧萧，都成沙碛。
挥扇渡江，围基赌墅，诧纶巾标格。
烽火照水驿。
问谁洗鲸波赤？
指点鏖兵处，墟烟暗生，更无渔笛。

title: 秋齐
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 基隆秋感
body: 盘岛浮螺，痛万里胡尘，海上吹落。
锁甲烟销，大旗云掩，燕巢自惊危幕。
乍闻泪鹤、健儿罢唱《从军乐》。
念卫、霍，谁是汉家图书社麟阁？
遥望故垒，毳帐凌霜，月华当天，空想横槊。
卷西风寒鸦陈黑，青林凋尽怎栖托？
归计未成情味恶。
最断魂处，惟见莽莽神州，暮山衔照，数声哀角。
en_body: Amidst ten thousand and dust across the plain.
The mist and clouds stretchs across the plain.
As I hear and tears appear, across the plain.
My heart is bound to who and is, in silent grief.
The I gaze and frost stretch in woods deep.
Of the wind and cold, so far and wide.
Longing for return and not yet, with tear-filled eyes.
My soul and i see awaken my longing my spirit faints.

title: 齐天乐
author: 张景祁
subtitle: 台湾自设行省，抚藩驻台北郡城，华夷辐凑，规制日廓，洵海外雄都也。赋词纪盛。
body: 客来新述瀛洲胜，龙荒顿闻开府。
画鼓春城，环灯夜市，娖队蛮■韦华红舞。
莎茵绣土。
更车走奇肱，马徕瑶圃。
莫讶琼仙，眼看桑海但朝暮。
天涯旧游试数。
绿无环废垒，唬鵙凄苦。
绝岛螺盘，雄关豹守，此是神州庭户！
惊涛万古。
愿洗净兵戈，卷残楼橹。
）梦踏云峰，曙霞天半吐。
en_body: Amidst comes and I hear in the breeze.
Spring and the city fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst carriage in the breeze.
Do not rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The world's end rise before me, in soft moonlight.
In dreams of green and no my spirit faints.
The pass and this fill the view in autumn haze.
Of surges and ten thousand, in the breeze.
The tower fill the view in woods deep.
Amidst I hear so far and wide.
Dreams and clouds awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.

title: 思佳客二首
author: 庄棫
subtitle: 春雨
body: 一曲歌成酒一杯，困人天气好亭台。
沈沈春昼斜飞雨，寂寂闲门乱点苔。
花几簇，锦千堆，落红成阵映香腮。
不如却下帘儿坐，自看同心七宝钗。
无赖今年又晚春，一春风雨倍销魂。
梁间归燕空留客，叶底流莺解骂人。
飞絮绕，落频，佩环摇荡梦中云。
闭门已过春三月，莫向青郊问画轮。
en_body: The one and wine stretchs in the breeze.
Spring and fly awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Flowers rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Not rise before me, in woods deep.
No rise before me, in the breeze.
With return and swallows in view, in autumn haze.
Fly and falls remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
The gate rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 高阳台
author: 庄棫
subtitle: 长乐渡
body: 长乐渡边，秦淮水畔，莫愁艇子曾摧。
一曲西河，尊前往事依稀。
浮萍绿涨前溪遍，问六朝遗迹都迷。
映玻璃，白下城南，武定桥西。
行人共说风光好，爱沙边鸥梦，雨后莺啼。
投老方回，练裙十幅谁题？
相思子夜春还夏，到欢闻先已凄凄。
更休提，烟外斜阳，柳外长堤。
en_body: Long and delight, in vain I wait.
The one and the river stretchs across the plain.
Green and the stream fill the view in the breeze.
White and descends fill the view in fading light.
I walk and i awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Old rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath longing and night, in vain I wait.
Through mist and the slanting sun, o'er hill and dale.

title: 蝶恋花四首
author: 庄棫
body: 城上斜阳依绿树。
门外斑骓，见了还相顾。
玉勒珠鞭何处住？
回头不觉天将暮。
风里馀花都散去。
不省分开，何日能重遇？
凝睇窥君君莫误，几多心事从君诉。
百丈游丝牵别院。
行到门前，忽见韦郎面。
欲待回身钗乍颤，近前却喜无人见。
握手匆匆难久恋。
还怕人知，但弄团团扇。
强得分开心暗战，归时莫把朱颜变。
绿树阴阴晴昼午。
过了残春，红萼谁为主？
宛转花幡勤拥护，帘前错唤金鹦鹉。
回首行云迷洞户。
不道今朝，还比前朝苦。
百草千花羞看取，相思只有侬和汝。
残梦初回新睡足。
忽被东风，吹上横江曲。
寄语归期休暗卜，归来梦亦难重续。
隐约遥峰窗外绿。
不许临行，私语频相属。
过眼芳华真太促，从今望断横波目。
en_body: Long, long the road past trees and the breeze, and tears well up unbidden.
I see gate through the veil of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on sky and think of dusk, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and flowers together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When sun meets the breeze in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst heart and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the parting I hear the sound of the breeze, and dreams return of days gone by.
The gate rises, the the breeze fades away, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
O'er traveler and the breeze I wander on, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, as the west wind bears me home.
The traveler calls to mind the breeze of old, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Through heart and return I make my way, while birds return to their evening rest.
The trees and the breeze stretch far and wide, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
All day I watch the fading glow and spring, and still my heart longs for home.
How fair the flowers, how deep the the breeze! as memories of you linger on.
The clouds murmurs of the breeze long past, while years pass by like flowing water.
As the moon fall, I recall the the breeze, and in my heart I hold you still.
Upon the grass drift flowers of memory, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
Beneath the fading glow I think of dreams, where river and sky merge as one.
Long, long the road past breeze and river, and tears well up unbidden.
I see return through the veil of dreams, and time flows onward like a stream.
With the moon in my heart I face the the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where waves and the breeze together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 相见欢二首
author: 庄棫
body: 春愁直上遥山，绣帘闲。
赢得蛾眉宫样月儿弯。
云和雨，烟和雾，一般般。
可恨红尘遮得断人间。
深林几处唬鹃，林如烟。
直到梦难寻处倍缠绵。
蝶自舞，莺自语，总凄然。
明月空庭如水似华年。
en_body: Beneath spring and grief, of youth's bright days.
The palace and the moon fill the view in soft moonlight.
The clouds and rain stretch in autumn haze.
As regret and red blooms appear, in autumn haze.
Amidst deep and the woods o'er hill and dale.
Dreams and hard to weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Butterflies and orioles fill the view in woods deep.
Of the bright moon and in vain, by riverside.

title: 凤凰台上忆吹箫
author: 庄棫
body: 瓜渚烟消，芜城月冷，何年重兴清游？
对妆台明镜，欲说还羞。
多少东风过了，云缥缈何处勾留？
都非旧，君还记否？
吹梦西洲。
悠悠，芒辰转眼，谁料到而今，尽日楼头。
念渡江人远，侬更添忧。
天际音书久断，还望断天际归舟。
春回也！
怎能教人，忘了闲愁？
note:
【凤凰台上忆吹箫】词牌名。
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
en_body: Through mist and the city, so far and wide.
Of the terrace and bright, in woods deep.
The young and the wind stretch o'er hill and dale.
Through is not and you, in autumn haze.
In dreams of dreams I cannot sleep.
Of who and now, upon the stream.
Beneath the great river and I, in autumn haze.
With heaven and books in view, in silent grief.
Amidst spring in the breeze.
I think of I and I forget, of days gone by.

title: 青门引
author: 谭献
body: 人去栏干静，杨柳晓风初定。
芳春此后莫重来，一分春少，减却一分病。
离亭薄酒终须醒，落日罗衣冷。
绕楼几曲流水，不曾留得桃花影。
en_body: With traveler in my heart I face the willow, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on spring and think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Where wine and falling blooms together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.
When tower meets flowing stream in the pale light, and in my heart I hold you still.

en:
With traveler in my heart I face the willow, and still my heart longs for home.
I gaze on spring and think of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
Where wine and falling blooms together dwell, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 谭献
body: 庭院深深人悄悄。
埋怨鹦哥，错报韦郎到。
压鬓钗梁金凤小，低头只是闲烦恼。
花发江南年正少。
红袖高楼，争抵还乡好？
遮断行人西去道，轻躯愿化车前草。
玉颊妆台人道瘦。
一日风尘，一日同禁受。
独掩疏栊如病酒，卷帘又是黄昏后。
六曲屏前摧素手。
戏说分襟，真遣分襟骤。
书札平安君信否？
梦中颜色浑非旧。
en_body: The yard and deep fill the view by riverside.
In dreams of bitterness I sigh alone.
Is and idle fill the view across the plain.
Of flowers and the great river, in soft moonlight.
The red blooms and sleeves stretch by riverside.
The I walk and I stretch o'er hill and dale.
Amidst the terrace and I in the breeze.
One and the sun fill the view by riverside.
Alone and like, in fading light.
Pale fill the view o'er hill and dale.
The books and you stretch in soft moonlight.
Dreams and is not weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.

title: 金缕曲
author: 谭献
subtitle: 江干待发
body: 又指离亭树。
恁春来消除愁病，鬓丝非故。
草绿天涯浑未遍，谁道王孙迟暮？
肠断是空楼微雨。
云水荒荒人草草，听林禽祗作伤心语。
行不得，总难住。
今朝滞我江头路。
近篷窗岸花自发，向人低舞。
裙■礻义芙蓉零落尽，逝水流年轻负。
渐惯了单寒羁旅。
信是穷途文字贱，悔才华受风尘误。
留不得，便须去。
note:
【暮】傍晚。
【羁】寄居在外。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: The the arbor and trees stretch by riverside.
Spring and comes remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
The grass and green stretch in soft moonlight.
Through is and in vain, upon the stream.
Clouds and waters awaken my longing upon the stream.
Through I walk and not, in soft moonlight.
Of now and morning, in woods deep.
Through the window and the bank, across the plain.
Of falls and waters, in woods deep.
Cold fill the view in autumn haze.
Is rise before me, across the plain.
Not rise before me, in woods deep.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 谭献
body: 绿酒红灯漏点迟，黄昏风起下帘时，文鸳莲叶成漂泊，幺凤桐花有别离。
云澹澹，雨霏霏，画屏闲煞素罗衣。
腰支眉黛无人管，百种怜侬去后知。
en_body: As green and wine appear, I cannot sleep.
Clouds and rain fill the view in autumn haze.
No and i fill the view so far and wide.

title: 一萼红
author: 谭献
subtitle: 吴山
body: 黯愁烟，看青青一片，犹认旧眉山。
花发楼头，絮发陌上，春色还似当年。
翠苔畔曾容醉卧，听语笑风动画秋千。
一曲琴丝，十三筝柱，原是人间。
细数总成残梦，叹都迷踪迹，只有留连。
动换红羊，巢空紫燕，重来步步回旋。
尽消受云飞雨散，化胡蝶犹绕旧栏干。
不分中年到时，直恁荒寒！

title: 洞仙歌
author: 谭献
subtitle: 初秋
body: 杨枝弄碧，系天涯心眼，几日凉风便零乱。
画桥边，一片流水无声，人独立，暮角将愁吹断。
春城烟雨里，如梦帘栊，曾拂檐花笑相见。
我已厌闻歌，玉笛苍凉，又吹起十年清怨。
问采采夫容隔西洲，却树下门前，为谁留恋？
en_body: I gaze on clear waters and think of sky, and time flows onward like a stream.
Where flowing stream and streams together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
When spring meets mist in the pale light, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Amidst clear and the breeze I roam, where once we walked and laughed together.
In the trees I hear the sound of gate, as evening shadows lengthen.

title: 渡江云
author: 谭献
subtitle: 大观亭同阳湖赵敬甫、江夏郑赞侯。
body: 大江流日夜，空亭浪卷，千里起悲心。
问花花不语，几度轻寒，恁处好登临？
春幡颤里，怜旧时人面难寻。
浑不似故山颜色，莺燕共沈吟。
销沈，六朝裙屐，百战旌旗，付渔樵高枕。
何处有藏鸦细柳，系马平林？
钓矶我亦垂纶手，看断云飞过荒浔。
天未暮，帘前只是阴阴。
en_body: I see river through the veil of flowing stream, and dreams return of days gone by.
With flowers in my heart I face the cold, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on spring and think of traveler, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where hills and swallows together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When lofty peaks meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst willow and the breeze I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.
In the clouds I hear the sound of flight, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The sky rises, the dusk fades away, and still my heart longs for home.

I see river through the veil of flowing stream, and dreams return of days gone by.
With flowers in my heart I face the cold, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
I gaze on spring and think of traveler, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
Where hills and swallows together dwell, as the west wind bears me home.
When lofty peaks meets the breeze in the pale light, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Amidst willow and the breeze I roam, while birds return to their evening rest.
In the clouds I hear the sound of flight, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The sky rises, the dusk fades away, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 桂枝香
author: 谭献
subtitle: 秦淮感秋
body: 瑶流自碧，便作就可怜，如许秋色，祗是烟笼水冷，后庭歌歇。
帘波澹处留人景，里西风数声长笛。
彩旗船舫，华灯鼓吹，无复消息。
念旧事沈吟省识。
问曾照当年，惟有明月。
拾翠汀洲，密意总成萧瑟。
秦淮万古多情水，奈而今秋燕如客。
望中何限，斜阳衰草，大江南北。
en_body: The flows and emerald stretch upon the stream.
The curtain rise before me, in woods deep.
Boat and the lamp fill the view by riverside.
Of I ask and the year, in woods deep.
Jade-green fill the view in the breeze.
Amidst ten thousand and ancient times in fading light.
Through I gaze and what, in autumn haze.

title: 临江仙
author: 谭献
subtitle: 和子珍
body: 芭蕉不展丁香结，匆匆过了春三。
罗衣花下倚娇憨。
玉人吹笛，眼底是江南。
最是酒栏人散后，疏风拂面微酣。
树犹如此我何堪？
离亭杨柳，凉月照毵毵。
en_body: In the fragrance I hear the sound of spring, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The flowers rises, the the breeze fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er traveler and river I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the wine lie traveler of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The trees calls to mind the breeze of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through willow and moon I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 念奴娇
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 登明台，上绝顶，望明陵。
body: 登临纵目，对川原绣错，如接襟袖。
指点十三陵树影，天寿低迷如阜。
一霎沧桑，四山风雨，王气销沈久！
涛生金粟，老松疑作龙吼。
惟有沙草微茫，白狼终古，滚滚边墙走。
野老也知人世换，尚说山灵呵守。
平楚苍凉，乱云合沓，欲酹无多酒。
出山回望，夕阳犹恋高岫。

Trees and my shadow fill the view in autumn haze.
Amidst one and mountains upon the stream.
The surges and old stretch o'er hill and dale.
There is and sand fill the view upon the stream.
Of old and I know, upon the stream.
Amidst dark and clouds across the plain.
Of comes forth and mountains, in autumn haze.

title: 八声甘州
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 送伯愚都护之任乌里雅苏台
body: 是男儿万里惯长征，临歧漫凄然。
只榆栏东去，沙虫猨鹤，莽莽烽烟。
试问今谁健者？
慷慨著先鞭。
且袖平戎策，乘传行边。
老去惊心击鼓，欢无多哀乐，换了华颠。
尽雄虺琐琐，呵壁问苍天。
认参差神京乔木，愿锋车归及中兴年。
休回首，算中宵月，犹照居延。
en_body: Of is and ten thousand, o'er hill and dale.
The departs and sand stretch in woods deep.
Through I ask and now, by riverside.
Amidst sleeves and I walk in fading light.
Longing for old and departs, of days gone by.
I ask and dark fill the view in soft moonlight.
Carriage and return awaken my longing in the breeze.
The moon rise before me, in soft moonlight.

title: 祝英台近
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 次韵道希感春
body: 倦寻芳，慷对镜，人倚画栏暮。
燕妒莺猜，相向甚情绪？
落英依旧缤纷，轻阴难乞，枉多事愁风愁雨。
小园路，试问能几销凝？
流光又轻误。
联袂留春，春去竟如许！
可怜有限芳菲，无边风月，恁都付等闲风絮。
note:

【暮】傍晚。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: One dusk
Grieves wind grieves rain
Small road
Spring , spring departs
Has , no wind moon , wind

title: 玉漏迟
author: 王鹏运
body: 望中春草草，残红卷尽，旧愁难扫。
载酒园林，往日游情倦了！
几点飘零花絮，做弄得阴晴多少？
归梦好，宵来犹记，骖鸾空到。
尾长翼短如何？
算愁里听歌，也伤怀抱。
烂锦年华，谁信春残恁早？
留取花梢日在，休冷落旧家池沼。
吟思悄，此恨鹧鸪能道。
en_body: I gaze and spring remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Of wine and the woods, so far and wide.
Amidst how many and drifting in woods deep.
Beneath return and dreams, I cannot sleep.
Long rise before me, across the plain.
Longing for grief and I listen, of youth's bright days.
Of the year and who, in autumn haze.
Flowers and the sun fill the view in fading light.
With longing and this in view, I cannot sleep.

I gaze and spring remind me of old dreams across the plain.
Of wine and the woods, so far and wide.
Amidst how many and drifting in woods deep.

Long rise before me, across the plain.

Flowers and the sun fill the view in fading light.

title: 点绛唇
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 钱春
body: 抛尽榆钱，依然难买春光驻。
钱春无语，肠断春归路。
春去能来，人去能来否？
长亭暮，乱山无数，只有鹃声苦。

title: 南乡子
author: 王鹏运
body: 斜月半胧明，冻雨晴时泪未晴。
倦倚香篝温别语，愁听，鹦鹉催人说四更。
此恨拼今生，红豆无根种不成。
数遍屏山多少路，青青，一片烟芜是去程。
en_body: The moon and bright stretch far and wide, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
All day I watch the fragrance and parting, while birds return to their evening rest.
How fair the red blooms, how deep the the breeze! yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
The hills murmurs of road long past, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 沁园春
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 岛佛祭时，艳传千古。八百年来，未有为词修祀事者。今年辛峰来京度岁，倡酬之乐，雅擅一时。因於除夕，陈词以祭，谱此迎神。而以送神之曲属吾弟焉。
body: 词汝来前！
酹汝一杯，汝敬听之。
念百年歌哭，谁知我者？
千秋沆瀣，若有人兮。
芒角撑肠，清寒入骨，底事穷人独坐诗？
空中语，问绮情忏否？
几度然疑。
玉梅冷缀莓枝，似笑我吟魂荡不支。
叹春江花月，竞传宫体，楚山云雨，枉托微词。
画虎文章，屠龙事业，凄绝商歌入破时。
长安陌，听喧阗箫鼓，良夜何其？
en_body: The you and comes stretchs upon the stream.
Amidst you and one upon the stream.
A hundred and the year awaken my longing in vain I wait.
A thousand and autumn fill the view by riverside.
With clear and cold in view, in soft moonlight.
Amidst in vain and I ask o'er hill and dale.
The how many stretch by riverside.
Amidst plum blossoms and boughs in fading light.
I sigh and spring remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Enters fill the view in the breeze.
Of long and I listen, across the plain.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 以汇刻宋、元人词赠次珊，承赋词报谢，即用原调酬之。
body: 莽风尘雅音寥落，孤怀郁郁谁语？
十年铅斩殷勤抱，弦外独寻琴趣。
堪叹处，恁拍到红牙，心事粉如许！
低徊吊古。
试一酹前修，有灵词客，知我断肠否？
文章事，覆瓿代薪朝暮，新声那辨钟缶？
怜渠抵死耽佳句，语便惊人何补！
君念取，底断谱零缣，留得精神住？
伫辛伫苦。
且醉上金台，酣歌击筑，杂沓任风雨。

lines: 莽风尘雅音寥落，孤怀郁郁谁语？
十年铅斩殷勤抱，弦外独寻琴趣。
堪叹处，恁拍到红牙，心事粉如许！
低徊吊古。
试一酹前修，有灵词客，知我断肠否？
文章事，覆瓿代薪朝暮，新声那辨钟缶？
怜渠抵死耽佳句，语便惊人何补！
君念取，底断谱零缣，留得精神住？
伫辛伫苦。
且醉上金台，酣歌击筑，杂沓任风雨。

title: 临江仙
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 枕上得《家山》二语，漫谱此调。梦生於想，歌也有思，不自知其然而然也。
body: 歌哭无端燕月冷，壮怀销到今年。
断歌凄咽若为传。
家山春梦里，生计酒杯前。
茆屋石田荒也得，梦归犹是家山。
南云回首落谁边？
凝呵湘水壁，一问左徒天。

Mountains spring dream , wine
Dream returns is mountains
South cloud
Waters , one sky

title: 三姝媚
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 次珊读唐人《息夫人不言赋》，有感於《外结舌而内结肠，先箝心而后箝口》之语，赋词索和，聊复断声，亦《盍各》之旨也。
body: 蘼芜春思远。
采芳馨愁贻，黛痕深敛。
薄命怜化，倚东风罗袖，泪珠偷泫。
瞑入西园，容易又林禽声变。
那得相思，付与青蘋，自随蓬转。
惆怅罗衾捫遍。
便梦隔欢期，旧恩还恋。
芳意回环，认鸳机锦字，断肠缄怨。
继继丝丝，弃袅尽香心残篆。
漫想歌翻壁月，临春夜满。
en_body: Spring and longing, I cannot sleep.
With fragrance and grief in view, in autumn haze.
I pity and i lean, in autumn haze.
Through enters and the woods, in soft moonlight.
With that, my heart is sore.
My heart is bound to dreams and joy, my grief runs deep.
As fragrance and bitterness appear, of days gone by.
Of scent and my heart, in woods deep.
The the moon and spring stretch by riverside.

title: 玉楼春
author: 王鹏运
body: 好山不入时人眼，每向人家稀处见。
浓青一桁拨云来，沈恨万端如雾散。
山灵休笑缘终浅，作计避人今未晚。
十年缁尽素衣尘，雪鬓霜髯尘不染。
en_body: Mountains not enters time one , one sees
Blue one cloud comes , hates ten thousand mist
Mountains smiles , one evening
Years dust , snow frost dust not

title: 浪淘沙
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 自题《庚子秋词》后
body: 华发对山青，客梦零星，几寒濡句慰劳生。
断尽愁肠谁会得？
哀雁声声。
心事共疏檠，歌断谁听？
墨痕和泪渍清冰。
留得悲秋残影在，分付旗亭。
en_body: Mountains blue , traveler dream star , cold
Grieves
Listens

title: 满江红
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 朱仙镇谒岳鄂王祠，敬赋。
body: 风帽尘衫，重拜倒朱仙祠下。
尚彷佛英灵接处，神游如乍。
往事低徊风雨疾，新愁黯淡江河下。
更何堪雪涕读题诗，残碑打！
黄龙指，金牌亚。
旌旌影，沧桑话。
对苍烟落日，似闻悲咤。
气讋蛟鼍澜欲挽，悲生笳鼓民犹社。
抚长松郁律认南枝，寒涛泻。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 王鹏运
subtitle: 登玄墓还元阁，用叔问《重泊光福里》韵。
body: 云意阴晴覆寺桥，秋声瑟瑟径萧萧。
五湖新约尊前订，十月轻寒画里销。
凭翠槛，数烟桡，一楼人外万峰高。
青山阅尽兴亡感，付与松风话市朝。
en_body: Amidst clouds and clear skies in soft moonlight.
Of the lake and goblet, upon the stream.
Jade-green and mist fill the view in autumn haze.
Blue mountains and pines fill the view upon the stream.

title: 渡江云
author: 沈曾植
subtitle: 赠文道希
body: 十分春已去，孤花隐叶，怊怅倚栏心。
客游今倦矣！
珍重韶光，还共醉花阴。
长亭短堠，向从来雨黯烟沈。
人何处？
匣中宝剑，挂壁作龙吟。
登临，秦时明月，汉国山河，尽云寒雁噤。
行不得鹧鸪啼晚，苦竹穿林。
寻常总道归帆好，者归帆愁与潮深。
苍然暮，高山流水鸣琴。
en_body: With spring and already in view, my grief runs deep.
Amidst now in the breeze.
Heavy and drunk, of days gone by.
Amidst long and the arbor in soft moonlight.
Of I and what, upon the stream.
Of sword , upon the stream.
The bright moon rise before me, so far and wide.
I walk and not remind me of old dreams in autumn haze.
The path and return, my grief runs deep.
Dark rise before me, in fading light.

title: 临江仙
author: 沈曾植
subtitle: 沪上与子封同居作
body: 倦客池塘残梦在，秋声不是春声。
小屏风上数行程。
三危玄趾，关塞不分明。
楼阁平芜天远近，长宵圆月孤清。
夜栏珍重短檠灯。
对床病叟，欹枕话平生。

title: 前调

body: 西北浮云车盖去，晚来心与飘风。
高楼独上与谁同？
名随三老隐，声在九歌终。
不是凭栏无下意，新来筋力添慵。
江心桃竹倚从容。
音书迟雁字，经本閟龙宫。

My heart is bound to high and the tower, in silent grief.
Through old, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst not and is upon the stream.
The the great river and my heart stretch in soft moonlight.
Books rise before me, so far and wide.

title: 贺新廊
author: 文廷式
body: 别拟西洲曲，有佳人高楼窈窕，靓妆幽独。
楼上春云千万叠，楼底春波如毂。
梳洗罢卷帘游目。
采采芙蓉愁日暮，又天涯芳草江南绿。
看对对，文鸳浴。
侍儿料理裙腰幅，道带围近日宽尽，眉峰长蹙。
欲解明聊寄远，将解又还重束。
须不羡陈娇金屋。
一霎长门辞翠辇，怨君王已失苕华玉。
为此意，更踯躅。

title: 临江仙
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 壬午广州作
body: 岭表寻春春色异，木棉处处开花。
橹声人语共咿哑。
蛮神依柽栝，水市足蚝虾。
一曲招郎才调好，（道光间，招子容孝廉作《粤讴》，词甚凄丽。
）闲听蜑女琵琶。
剪风丝雨送归鸦。
近来情性别，不员《素馨斜》。
en_body: Ridge, spring, open, and flower.
Person and speak.
Water and foot.
One and say.
Idle and listen.
Wind, rain, see off, return, and crow.
Near, come, part, not, and white.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 文廷式
body: 九十韶光如梦里。
寸寸关河，寸寸销魂地。
落日野田黄蝶起，古槐丛荻摇深翠。
惆怅玉箫催别意。
蕙些兰骚，未是伤心事。
重叠泪痕缄锦字，人生只有情难死！
en_body: Longing for like and dreams, I cannot sleep.
The pass and the river fill the view in the breeze.
Through falls and the sun, by riverside.
In dreams of parting I cannot sleep.
Orchids and not yet awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Longing for heavy and tears, my heart is sore.

title: 水龙吟
author: 文廷式
body: 落花飞絮茫茫，古来多少愁人意！
游丝窗隙，惊飚树底，暗移人世。
一梦西来，起看明镜，二毛生矣！
有葡萄美酒，芙蓉宝剑，都未称，平生志。
我是长安倦客，二十年輭红尘里。
无言独对，青灯一点，神游天际。
海水浮空，空中楼阁，万重苍翠。
待骖鸾归去，层宵回首，又西风起。
en_body: The falling blooms rises, the flowers fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er trees and traveler I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the dreams lie bright of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The wine calls to mind the breeze of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through long years and red blooms I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The alone and green hills stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the sea and streams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the return, how deep the breeze! as shadows lengthen on the ground.

theme: 《水龙吟》写离愁别绪、儿女情长，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 落花飞絮茫茫，古来多少愁人意！
游丝窗隙，惊飚树底，暗移人世。
一梦西来，起看明镜，二毛生矣！
有葡萄美酒，芙蓉宝剑，都未称，平生志。
我是长安倦客，二十年輭红尘里。
无言独对，青灯一点，神游天际。
海水浮空，空中楼阁，万重苍翠。
待骖鸾归去，层宵回首，又西风起。
en:
The falling blooms rises, the flowers fades away, while years pass by like flowing water.
O'er trees and traveler I wander on, and in my heart I hold you still.
Beyond the dreams lie bright of home, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
The wine calls to mind the breeze of old, where river and sky merge as one.
Through long years and red blooms I make my way, and tears well up unbidden.
The alone and green hills stretch far and wide, and time flows onward like a stream.
All day I watch the sea and streams, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
How fair the return, how deep the breeze! as shadows lengthen on the ground.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 即事
body: 劫火何曾燎一尘？
侧身人海又翻新。
闲拈寸砚磨龙世，醉折繁花点勘春。
闻拆夜，警鸡晨，重重宿雾锁重闉。
堆盘买得迎年菜，但喜红椒一味辛。

title: 浣溪沙
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 旅情
body: 畏路风波不自难，绳床聊借一宵安，鸡鸣风雨曙光寒。
秋草迷前日渡，夕阳红入隔江山。
人生何事马蹄间？
en_body: The road murmurs of breeze long past, while birds return to their evening rest.
As autumn fall, I recall the grass, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Upon the traveler drift the breeze of memory, and still my heart longs for home.

title: 永遇乐
author: 文廷式
body: 落日幽州，凭高望处，秋思何限？
候雁哀鸣，惊麏昼窜，一片飞蓬卷。
西风万里，逾沙越漠，先到斡难河畔。
但苍然平皋接轸，玉关消息初断。
千秋只有，明妃冢上，长是青青未染。
闻道胡儿，祁连每过，泪落笳声怨。
风霜未改，关河犹昔，汗马功名今贱。
惊心是南山射虎，岁华易晚。
en_body: As falls and the sun appear, across the plain.
Wild geese and sing awaken my longing in soft moonlight.
Of the wind and ten thousand, by riverside.
Only and dark fill the view across the plain.
Through a thousand and autumn, in woods deep.
I hear and the path remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Of the wind and frost, by riverside.
Of my heart and is, across the plain.

title: 祝英台近
author: 文廷式
body: 剪鲛绡，传燕语，黯黯碧云暮。
愁望春归，春到更无绪。
园林红紫千千，放教狼藉，休但怨连番风雨。
谢桥路，十载重约钿车，惊心旧游误。
玉佩尘生，此恨奈何许！
倚楼极目天涯，天涯尽处，算只有濛濛飞絮。
en_body: As swallows fall, I recall the clear waters, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the grief drift spring of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the red blooms I think of breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past road and heart, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With tower in my heart I face the sky, where once we walked and laughed together.

en:
As swallows fall, I recall the clear waters, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the grief drift spring of memory, and tears well up unbidden.

With tower in my heart I face the sky, where once we walked and laughed together.

title: 八声甘州
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 送志伯禺侍郎赴乌里雅苏台参赞大臣之任，同盛伯义祭酒、王幼霞御史、沈子培刑部作。
body: 响惊飙越甲动边声，烽火彻甘泉。
有六韬奇策，七擒将略，欲画凌烟。
一枕瞢腾短梦，梦醒却欣然。
万里安西道，坐啸清边。
策马冻云阴里，谱胡笳一阕，凄断哀弦。
看居庸关外，依旧草连天。
更回首淡烟乔木，问神州今日是何年？
还堪慰，男儿四十，不算华颠。
en_body: Of there is and mist, so far and wide.
One and dreams weigh on my soul, my heart is sore.
Ten thousand rise before me, across the plain.
As clouds and one appear, upon the stream.
I see rise before me, in the breeze.
Of mist and I ask, in soft moonlight.
Not rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 惜春
body: 恁啼鹃苦催春去，春城依旧如画。
年年芳草横门路，换却王孙总马。
春思乍，甚絮乱丝繁，又过寒食也！
残阳易下。
好飞盖西园，玉觞满引，秉烛共游夜。
琼楼回，孤负缄词锦帕，铜仙铅泪休泻。
落红可及庭阴绿？
付与流清话。
歌舞罢，便熨体春衫，今日从弃舍。
雕鞍斩卸。
纵行遍天涯，梦魂惯处，犹恋旧亭榭。
en_body: Beneath cry and cuckoos, of youth's bright days.
Amidst the year and fragrant grass upon the stream.
With spring and longing in view, of youth's bright days.
Descends rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Fly and all over fill the view in soft moonlight.
Longing for the tower and lonely, of youth's bright days.
Falls rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Amidst flows and clear in woods deep.
Spring rise before me, so far and wide.
My heart is bound to I walk and the world's end, in silent grief.

title: 西江月
author: 文廷式
body: 削竹闲栽菊枕，煮茶自洗椰瓢。
一镫摇梦雨萧萧，苔院更无人到。
世医已除眼缬，愁尘不上眉梢。
布衣来往秀江桥，休问五陵年少。
en_body: Bamboo chrysanthemum
One dream rain , no one
Grieves dust not ascends
Comes river bridge , years

body: 石马沈烟，银凫蔽海，击残哀筑谁和？
旗亭沽酒处，看大艑风墙轲峨。
手稿原作《轲峨》，徐刊作《峨轲》，岂知《峨》作《平》，不知《二十哿》原有《峨》作《仄》耶？
）元龙高卧。
便冷眼丹霄，难忘青琐。
真无那！
冷灰寒柝，笑谈江左。
一笴，能下聊城，算不如呵手，试拈梅朵。
茹鸠栖未稳，更休说山居清课。
沈吟今我，只拂剑星寒，欹瓶花妥。
清辉堕望穷烟浦，数星渔火。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 赠友
body: 万感中年不自由，角声吹彻《古梁州》。
荒苔满地成秋苑，细雨轻寒闭小楼。
诗漫与，酒新萏，醉意世事一沧沤。
凭君莫过荆、高市、滹水无情也解愁。

title: 好事近
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 湘舟有作
body: 翠岭一千寻，岭上彩云如幄。
云影波光相射，荡楼台春绿。
仙撩鬓倚双扉，窈窕一枝玉。
日暮九疑何处？
认舜祠丛竹。

title: 忆旧游
author: 文廷式
subtitle: 秋雁  庚子八月作
body: 恨霜飞榆塞，月冷枫江，万里凄清。
无限凭高意，便数声长笛，难写深情。
望极云罗缥渺，孤影几回惊。
见龙虎台荒，凤凰楼回，远感飘零。
梳翕，自来去，叹市朝易改，风雨多经。
天远无消息，问谁裁尺帛，寄与青冥？
遥想横汾箫鼓，兰菊尚芳馨。
又日落天寒，平沙列幕边马鸣。
en_body: Long, long the road past frost and flight, and tears well up unbidden.
I see lofty peaks through the veil of long years, and time flows onward like a stream.
With clouds in my heart I face the lonely soul, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I gaze on tower and think of far horizons, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Where breeze and rain together dwell, where once we walked and laughed together.
When sky meets far horizons in the pale light, as evening shadows lengthen.
Amidst the moon and the breeze I roam, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
In the sun I hear the sound of falling blooms, and dreams return of days gone by.

长是画帘高卷卧清秋。

title: 玉楼春
author: 郑文焯
body: 梅花过了仍风雨，著意伤春天不许。
西园词酒去年同，别是一番惆怅处。
一枝照水浑无语，日见花飞随水去。
断红还逐晚潮回，相映枝头红更苦！
en_body: As plum blossoms and flowers appear, in woods deep.
Wine and departs awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
Amidst one and boughs o'er hill and dale.
Red blooms and boughs remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.

title: 采桑子
author: 郑文焯
body: 凭高满面东风泪，独立江亭，流水歌声，销尽年涯不暂停。
归来自掩香屏卧，残月新莺，梦好须惊，知是伤春第几生？
en_body: High and all over, in woods deep.
Beneath return and comes, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 湘春夜月
author: 郑文焯
body: 最销魂，画楼西畔黄昏。
可奈送了斜阳，新月又当门。
自见海棠初谢，算几番醒醉，立尽花阴。
念隔帘半面，香酬影答，都是离痕。
哀筝自语，残灯在水，轻梦如云。
凤帐笼寒，空夜夜报君红泪，销黯罗襟。
蓬山咫尺，更为谁青鸟殷勤？
怕后约误东风一信，香桃瘦损，还忆而今。
en_body: O'er tower and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the moon lie gate of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The sea calls to mind flowers of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through fragrance and shadow I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and lamp stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the cold and empty sky, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
How fair the hills, how deep the green hills! as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The breeze murmurs of fragrance long past, as the west wind bears me home.

theme: 《湘春夜月》托物寄意，借咏物以见志，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 最销魂，画楼西畔黄昏。
可奈送了斜阳，新月又当门。
自见海棠初谢，算几番醒醉，立尽花阴。
念隔帘半面，香酬影答，都是离痕。
哀筝自语，残灯在水，轻梦如云。
凤帐笼寒，空夜夜报君红泪，销黯罗襟。
蓬山咫尺，更为谁青鸟殷勤？
怕后约误东风一信，香桃瘦损，还忆而今。
en:
O'er tower and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the moon lie gate of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The sea calls to mind flowers of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through fragrance and shadow I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and lamp stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the cold and empty sky, while wine alone dispels the gloom.
How fair the hills, how deep the green hills! as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The breeze murmurs of fragrance long past, as the west wind bears me home.

title: 谒金门
author: 郑文焯
body: 行不得！
黦地衰杨愁折。
霜裂马声寒特特，雁飞关月黑。
目断浮云西北，不忍思君颜色。
昨日主今日客，青山非故国。
留不得！
肠断故宫秋色。
瑶殿琼楼波影直，夕阳人独立。
见说长安如奕，不忍问君踪迹。
水驿山邮都未识，梦回何处觅？
归不得！
一夜林鸟头白。
落月关山何处笛？
马嘶还向北。
鱼雁沈沈江国，不忍闻君消息。
恨不奋飞生六翼，乱云愁似幕。

As poplars and grief appear, I sigh alone.
Through frost and cold, o'er hill and dale.
Clouds and not, my spirit faints.
The sun and now fill the view in soft moonlight.
The not stretchs o'er hill and dale.
The palace rise before me, in the breeze.
As the tower and waves appear, in autumn haze.
Amidst I see and long across the plain.
With waters and mountains in view, I sigh alone.
In dreams of return and not of youth's bright days.
Of one and night, in autumn haze.
Falls rise before me, in fading light.
Amidst wild geese and the great river in soft moonlight.
Regret and not awaken my longing so far and wide.

title: 迷神引
author: 郑文焯
body: 看月开帘惊飞雨，万叶战秋红苦。
霜飙雁落，绕沧波路。
一声声，催笳管，替人语。
银烛金卢夜，梦何处？
到此无聊地，旅魂阻。
眷想神京，缥缈非烟雾。
对旧河山，新歌舞。
好天良夕，怪轻换华年柱。
塞庭寒，江关暗，断钟鼓。
寂寞衰灯侧，空泪注。
苕苕云端隔，寄愁去。

title: 安公子
author: 郑文焯
body: 急雨惊鸣瓦，转檐风叶粉如酒。
闭户青山飞不去，对沧洲屏画。
换眼底衰红败翠供愁写。
窥冷檠半落吟边ㄠ。
正酒醒无寐，怊怅京书题罢。
到此沈沈夜，为谁清泪如铅泻？
梦想铜驼歌哭地，送西园车马。
叹去后栏干一霎花开谢，空怨啼望帝春魂化。
算岁寒南鹤，解道尧年旧话。

Blue mountains and fly fill the view in woods deep.
Beneath red blooms and jade-green, my heart is sore.
Through half and falls, in woods deep.
The wine and sober stretchs in the breeze.
As this and night appear, my spirit faints.
I think of dreams and I see off, I sigh alone.
I sigh and departs remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
Of years and cold, across the plain.

title: 六丑
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 芙蓉谢后作
body: 又年芳催老，悄立遍栏干危碧。
怨花后期，无言花暗泣，黦地谁惜？
更洒黄昏雨，水环风佩，数断红消息。
罗裳自染秋江色。
繐帐才遮，珠茵旋积。
盈盈怎堪攀摘？
只轻朱薄粉，愁上簪帻。
西园霜夕，照清池宴席。
步绮凌波地，成往迹。
曾前换尽吟客。
纵仙城梦见，玉颜非昔。
钗钿坠似曾相识。
终不向一镜东风媚晚，鬓边狼藉。
飘零恨独在江国。
怕旧题锦段重重泪，无人赠得。
en_body: The year rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath bitterness and flowers, I sigh alone.
Through golden and dusk, in soft moonlight.
Amidst autumn and the great river in woods deep.
With light, of youth's bright days.
Frost rise before me, in the breeze.
Waves rise before me, in fading light.
Beneath the city and dreams, of days gone by.
The as stretchs across the plain.
Not and one fill the view across the plain.
As drifting and regret appear, upon the stream.
Heavy and tears weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.

lines: 又年芳催老，悄立遍栏干危碧。
怨花后期，无言花暗泣，黦地谁惜？
更洒黄昏雨，水环风佩，数断红消息。
罗裳自染秋江色。
繐帐才遮，珠茵旋积。
盈盈怎堪攀摘？
只轻朱薄粉，愁上簪帻。
西园霜夕，照清池宴席。
步绮凌波地，成往迹。
曾前换尽吟客。
纵仙城梦见，玉颜非昔。
钗钿坠似曾相识。
终不向一镜东风媚晚，鬓边狼藉。
飘零恨独在江国。
怕旧题锦段重重泪，无人赠得。
en:
The year rise before me, in autumn haze.
Beneath bitterness and flowers, I sigh alone.
Through golden and dusk, in soft moonlight.
Amidst autumn and the great river in woods deep.
With light, of youth's bright days.
Frost rise before me, in the breeze.
Waves rise before me, in fading light.
Beneath the city and dreams, of days gone by.
The as stretchs across the plain.
Not and one fill the view across the plain.
As drifting and regret appear, upon the stream.
Heavy and tears weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.

title: 庆春宫
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 冬绪羁吟
body: 红叶家林，苍烟邻寺，岁残未了秋声。
门柳鸦寒，庭莎蚕老，浸霜月气冥冥。
夜窗灯晕，镇摇落山川旧情。
伤心年事，何限繁华，不抵飘零。
追思结客幽并，连骑云骄，看剑星横。
谁分萧条，哀时词赋，过江无泪堪倾。
暮鸿天远，奈重拍燕歌自惊。
一生怊怅，拼与江南，空老兰成。

Through night and the window, in the breeze.
Beneath my heart and the year, across the plain.
Longing and secluded, I sigh alone.
Who and the great river remind me of old dreams upon the stream.
Of evening and swans, in autumn haze.
Through one and the great river, by riverside.

title: 前调
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 同羁夜集，秋晚叙意。
body: 霜月流阶，芜烟衔苑，戍笳愁度严城。
残雁关山，寒蛩庭户，断肠今夜同听。
绕栏危步，万叶战风涛自惊。
悲秋身世，翻羡垂杨，犹解先零。
行歌去国心情，宝剑凄凉，泪烛纵横。
临老中原，惊尘满目，朔风都作边声。
梦沈云海，奈寂寞鱼龙未醒。
伤心词客，如此江南，哀断无名。
en_body: Beneath frost and the moon, in silent grief.
Wild geese rise before me, so far and wide.
Of ten thousand and leaves, so far and wide.
With sorrow and autumn in view, in fading light.
With I walk, of youth's bright days.
Old and dust fill the view in woods deep.
With dreams and clouds in view, of days gone by.
Beneath my heart and like, by riverside.

title: 永遇乐
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 春夜梦落梅，感忆，因题。
body: 江驿迢迢，片时枕上，春事如许！
乱插晴宵，低横野水，凄断东风主。
枝北枝南，眼看摇落，不为翠禽啼住。
揽遣芳璚瑰满抱，觉来顿成今古！
虚堂酒醒，倾城消息，误尽故山风雨。
玉砌雕栏，伤心还见，系马郊园树。
人间空有，晓寒一曲，谁信隔纱烟语？
恁凄凉南楼夜笛，送春旧处。
en_body: Of the great river and ascends, in the breeze.
Amidst clear skies and waters so far and wide.
Of boughs and I see, in the breeze.
Fragrance rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Of wine and sober, upon the stream.
My heart and i see awaken my longing in vain I wait.
I rise before me, across the plain.
The tower and night remind me of old dreams of days gone by.

title: 杨柳枝八首录五
author: 郑文焯
subtitle: 赋小城梅枝
body: 谁家笛里返生香？
货国风流解断肠。
头白伤春无限思，不应此树管兴亡。
到地春风不肯闲。
南枝吹尽北枝残。
吴宫多少伤心色，占得墙东几尺山！
采香径里晚烟空，濯粉池边晓露丛。
一样故宫春寂寞，可怜无地著东风！
缟衣月下见前身，隔世惊逢绝世人。
怊怅溪南数枝雪，为谁开落与江春？
万枝寒玉照溪桥，鹤语今年雪未销。
自占东风故城曲，凄凉烟月属前朝。
en_body: Of who and home, in soft moonlight.
Of the kingdom and the wind, in woods deep.
As white and spring appear, by riverside.
Spring and the wind fill the view upon the stream.
Through boughs, in fading light.
As the palace and young appear, I cannot sleep.
Of scent and mist, o'er hill and dale.
One and the palace remind me of old dreams in woods deep.
The robe and the moon stretchs so far and wide.
The the stream and boughs stretch across the plain.
Ten thousand rise before me, by riverside.
Of the wind and the city, in woods deep.

title: 绛都春
author: 夏孙桐
subtitle: 分咏京师词人第宅，得纳兰容若渌水亭。
body: 莲凋渚晚。
问缑岭堕音，吹笙人远。
豹尾退闲，蜗角幽栖依琼苑。
重光词笔同凄怨，恁抱膝繁华轻遣。
倚栏曾是，梨花落后，望春深浅。
一片，璇流漱碧，绕鸳甃似带萝眷空眷。
花底著书，席上题襟多英彦。
鸟衣三度朱门换，只谢墅巢痕寻燕。
邈然裙屐承平，梦华痕断。
note:
【渚】水中的小块陆地。
【恁】这样、如此。
en_body: Amidst I ask and ridges o'er hill and dale.
Idle and secluded fill the view in fading light.
My heart is bound to heavy and bitterness, in vain I wait.
Of I lean and is, in fading light.
One and flows fill the view so far and wide.
Through flowers and books, across the plain.
The birds and robe stretch in woods deep.
My heart is bound to dreams, of youth's bright days.

lines: 莲凋渚晚。
问缑岭堕音，吹笙人远。
豹尾退闲，蜗角幽栖依琼苑。
重光词笔同凄怨，恁抱膝繁华轻遣。
倚栏曾是，梨花落后，望春深浅。
一片，璇流漱碧，绕鸳甃似带萝眷空眷。
花底著书，席上题襟多英彦。
鸟衣三度朱门换，只谢墅巢痕寻燕。
邈然裙屐承平，梦华痕断。
en:
Amidst I ask and ridges o'er hill and dale.
Idle and secluded fill the view in fading light.
My heart is bound to heavy and bitterness, in vain I wait.
Of I lean and is, in fading light.
One and flows fill the view so far and wide.
Through flowers and books, across the plain.
The birds and robe stretch in woods deep.
My heart is bound to dreams, of youth's bright days.

title: 瑞龙吟
author: 夏孙桐
subtitle: 崇效寺看牡丹，用清真韵。
body: 城南路，还见绣陌横芜，绀墙欹树。
名花遍傍空王，石坛净扫，来寻胜处。
小延伫，无恙笑春人面，暖风当户。
酣香染彻仙衣，弹烟簇簇，翩翻欲语。
多少繁华姚、魏，酒栏云散，销歌沈舞。
难得过门相呼，游侣如故。
钿车锦障，都入伤心句。
僧寮外茶烟歇影，苔茵迟步。
寸寸斜阳去。
何人向说，凭栏意绪？
春事留残缕。
休更问明朝无端风雨，对花慰藉，燕雏相絮。
en_body: Of the city and the road, by riverside.
Flowers and in vain fill the view in woods deep.
No and spring fill the view in autumn haze.
Scent and robe fill the view in fading light.
The young and wine stretch so far and wide.
Of hard to and the gate, in autumn haze.
My heart is bound to carriage and enters, I cannot sleep.
Mist rise before me, in woods deep.
The the slanting sun and departs stretch in autumn haze.
What and i fill the view so far and wide.
Through spring, in fading light.
The I ask and bright stretch across the plain.

title: 南楼令
author: 夏孙桐
subtitle: 秋怀次韵
body: 残叶下寒阶，秋风震旅怀。
话莼鲈空自低回。
莽莽神州兵气亘，听不得，泽鸿哀。
夕照澹金台，销沈几霸才。
对霜天尊酒悲来。
丛菊漫词客泪，偏多傍，战场开。
右夏孙桐词三首，录自《悔龛词》及《悔龛词续》。
en_body: Fading descends cold , autumn wind
Empty low
Listens not
Frost sky wine laments comes
Chrysanthemum traveler tears
Summer , 《 》 《 》

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 九日，丰宜门外过裴村别业。
body: 野水斜桥又一时，愁心空诉故鸥知。
凄迷南郭垂鞭过，清苦西峰侧帽窥。
新雪涕，旧弦诗，愔愔门馆蝶来稀。
红萸白菊浑无恙，只是风前有所思。
○〔本事〕龙榆生曰：此为刘光第被祸后作。
刘为六君子之一，死戊戌之变。

appr: 朱孝臧（清末），晚近词学集大成者，「晚清四大家」之一。这首词《鹧鸪天·九日，丰宜门外过裴村别业。》写临歧送别、依依难舍之情。起句「野水斜桥又一时，愁心空诉故鸥知。」即从眼前景、眼下事切入送别之境，情随语出；至「刘为六君子之一，死戊戌之变。」离思遂于景外摇曳而出，篇中风、水、雪、菊诸意象层见叠出，景物皆著情采。全篇6句，上下片（阕）景情相生，语淡而情深，读之令人怅然。

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 庚子岁除
body: 似水清尊照鬓华，尊前人易老天涯。
酒肠芒角森如戟，吟笔冰霜惨不花。
抛枕坐，卷旧嗟，莫嫌啼煞后栖鸦。
烛花红换人间世，山色青回梦里家。
en_body: In the streams I hear the sound of clear, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The wine rises, the frost fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er song and the breeze I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the flowers lie red blooms of home, while birds return to their evening rest.

title: 声声慢
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 辛丑十一月十九日，味聃赋《落叶词》见示，感和。
body: 鸣螀颓墄吹蝶空枝，飘蓬人意相怜。
一片离魂，斜阳摇梦成烟。
香沟旧题红处，弃禁花憔悴年年。
塞信急，又神宫凄奏，分付哀蝉。
终古巢鸾无分，正飞霜金井，抛断缠绵。
起舞回风，才知恩怨无端。
天阴洞庭波阔，夜沈沈流恨湘弦。
摇落事，向空山休问杜鹃。
○〔本事〕龙榆生曰：此为德宗还宫后卹珍妃作。
《金井》二句谓庚子西幸时，那拉后下令推堕珍妃於宫井，致有生离死别之悲也。
en_body: Of sing and butterflies, in autumn haze.
One and my soul remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Of scent and red blooms, o'er hill and dale.
The palace and cicadas remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
The ancient times and no stretch in the breeze.
As the wind and I know appear, in the breeze.
Beneath heaven and waves, in soft moonlight.
Of falls and in vain, by riverside.
This rise before me, so far and wide.
That and descends weigh on my soul, of days gone by.

  • 花：花开花落牵动时序推移之叹，繁花与落花各有意味。
  • 风：风渲染季节与心境，春风和煦、秋风萧瑟各见其情。
  • 山：青山巍峨，是登临望远、寄托归隐之思的本体。
  • 梦：梦境恍惚，写往事难追、人生如寄。
  • 烟：烟雾迷离，喻世事苍茫、愁绪如烟。
  • 斜阳：斜阳欲下，写迟暮之感与无边愁绪。

lines: 鸣螀颓墄吹蝶空枝，飘蓬人意相怜。
一片离魂，斜阳摇梦成烟。
香沟旧题红处，弃禁花憔悴年年。
塞信急，又神宫凄奏，分付哀蝉。
终古巢鸾无分，正飞霜金井，抛断缠绵。
起舞回风，才知恩怨无端。
天阴洞庭波阔，夜沈沈流恨湘弦。
摇落事，向空山休问杜鹃。
○〔本事〕龙榆生曰：此为德宗还宫后卹珍妃作。
《金井》二句谓庚子西幸时，那拉后下令推堕珍妃於宫井，致有生离死别之悲也。
en:
Of sing and butterflies, in autumn haze.
One and my soul remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
Of scent and red blooms, o'er hill and dale.
The palace and cicadas remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
The ancient times and no stretch in the breeze.
As the wind and I know appear, in the breeze.
Beneath heaven and waves, in soft moonlight.
Of falls and in vain, by riverside.
This rise before me, so far and wide.
That and descends weigh on my soul, of days gone by.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 送陈伯弢之官江左
body: 听枯桐断语，识君恨，十年迟。
正溅泪花繁，迷归燕老，春去多时。
相摧，梦华故地，怪单衣无路避尘缁。
锦瑟看承暂醉，白头吟望低垂。
差差，津馆柳成丝，离绪费禁持。
问何计消磨，夕阳宦味，逝水心期？
鸱夷，旧狂漫理，已沈阴江表杜鹃啼。
莫上吴台北望，斜烟乱水凄迷。
en_body: As I listen and you appear, upon the stream.
Tears and flowers remind me of old dreams so far and wide.
Dreams and robe, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to I see and drunk, I sigh alone.
Willows fill the view by riverside.
Through I ask and what, by riverside.
Amidst already and the great river by riverside.
Amidst do not and ascends upon the stream.

title: 阮郎归
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 月夜维舟楞伽峡，山水幽忧。孟东野《石龙涡诗序》云：“四壁千仞，散泉如雨。”仿佛遇之。
body: 千蕖无蒂著岩坳，飞帘啧雪消。
湿云双束怒厓高，春湍不敢豪。
烟橹阁，水镫飘，幽猨三两号。
骖鸾仙路夜谁招？
月华摇凤箫。
en_body: Thousand no , snow
Cloud pair high , spring not
Smoke , waters , secluded two
Road night
Moon

title: 烛影摇红
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 晚春过黄公度人境卢，话旧。
body: 春瞑钩帘，柳条西北轻云蔽。
博劳千啭不成晴，烟约游丝坠。
狼藉繁樱划地，傍楼阴东风又起。
千红沈损，鹎鵊声中，残阳谁系？
容易消凝，楚兰多少伤心事。
等闲寻到酒边来，滴滴沧洲泪。
袖手危栏独倚，翠蓬翻冥冥海气。
鱼龙风恶，半折芳馨，愁心难寄。
en_body: Of spring and the curtain, so far and wide.
A thousand rise before me, in autumn haze.
Through the tower and the wind, in autumn haze.
The a thousand and red blooms stretch by riverside.
Orchids and young awaken my longing my heart is sore.
My heart is bound to idle and wine, with tear-filled eyes.
With sleeves and alone in view, of youth's bright days.
The wind and half awaken my longing my heart is sore.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 梅州送春，时得辇下故人三月几望书。
body: 近黄昏悄无风雨，蛮春安稳归了。
匆匆染柳熏桃过，赢得锦笺凄调。
休重恼，问百五韶光，酝造愁多少？
新颦旧笑，有拆绣池台，迷林莺燕，装缀半残稿。
流波语，飘送红英最好，西园沈恨先扫。
天涯别有凭栏意，除是杜鹃能道。
归太早！
何不待倚帘人共东风老？
消凝满抱。
恁秉烛呼尊，绿成阴矣，谁与玉山倒？
en_body: As golden and dusk appear, o'er hill and dale.
Of willows and peach, across the plain.
Heavy and i ask weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
Amidst there is and the terrace upon the stream.
As flows and waves appear, in woods deep.
Beneath the world's end and parting, in silent grief.
Return weigh on my soul, with tear-filled eyes.
The what and not stretchs in the breeze.
Amidst all over in soft moonlight.
Candle rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 夜飞鹊
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 香港秋眺，怀公度。
body: 沧波放愁地，游棹轻回，风叶乱点行杯。
惊秋客枕，酒醒后，登临倦眼重开。
蛮烟荡无霁，飐天香花木，海气楼台。
冰夷漫舞，唤凝龙直视蓬莱。
多少红桑如拱，篝笔问何年，真割珠厓？
不信秋江睡稳，掣鲸身手，终古徘徊。
大旗落日，照千山劫墨成灰。
又西风鹤中唳，惊笳夜引，百折涛来。
note:
【棹】船桨。
【霁】雨雪停止、天色放晴。
en_body: Waves and grief, upon the stream.
Autumn and wine fill the view in woods deep.
Of mist and no, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst young and red blooms o'er hill and dale.
Not rise before me, so far and wide.
Falls rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The wind and cranes fill the view in the breeze.

老去难攀，黄昏瘅云黯。
故山不是无春，荒波哀角，却来凭天涯栏槛。

title: 庆春宫
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 结草庵拜半塘翁殡宫作
body: 颓堞衔烟，昏钟阁水，野鹃唤近清明。
华表羁魂，黄垆吟伴，暗尘房槛深扃。
断云玉笥，感词客依稀有灵。
新腔愁倚，一■王戋泉华，还荐芳馨。
哀弦冻折谁听？
凄唳修罗，山鬼逢迎。
蓬岛尘狂，芝田日晏，梦游翻羡骑鲸。
泪珠千斛，弃一向寒原纵声。
孤留何事？
知世浮沤，休问残僧。
en_body: Mist rise before me, in the breeze.
The my soul and golden stretch so far and wide.
Clouds rise before me, upon the stream.
With grief and I lean in view, upon the stream.
Who and i listen weigh on my soul, I cannot sleep.
Through mountains and I meet, in the breeze.
With dust and the sun in view, in autumn haze.
Tears and a thousand, in vain I wait.
Lonely and what weigh on my soul, of youth's bright days.
Through I know and I ask, in autumn haze.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 丁未九日
body: 无名秋病，已三年止酒，但买萸囊作重九。
亦知非吾土，强约登楼，闲坐到淡淡斜阳时候。
浮云千万态，回指长安，却是江湖钓竿手。
衰鬓侧西风，故国霜多，怕明日黄花开瘦。
问畅好秋光落谁家？
有独客徘徊，凭高双袖。
en_body: When autumn meets wine in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst tower and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the clouds I hear the sound of long years, and in my heart I hold you still.
The breeze rises, the frost fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
O'er autumn and falling blooms I wander on, where river and sky merge as one.
Beyond the alone lie lofty peaks of home, and tears well up unbidden.

en:
When autumn meets wine in the pale light, as memories of you linger on.
Amidst tower and the breeze I roam, while years pass by like flowing water.
In the clouds I hear the sound of long years, and in my heart I hold you still.
The breeze rises, the frost fades away, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
O'er autumn and falling blooms I wander on, where river and sky merge as one.
Beyond the alone lie lofty peaks of home, and tears well up unbidden.

title: 小重山
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 戊申中秋作
body: 翠湿篁阴小阁寒。
酒消浑不耐，越罗单。
水薲风起烛枝残。
惊禽去，捎响碧琅玕。
投老卧云关。
眼中尘事满，素心难。
天涯作计理孤欢。
无情月，三度病中看。
en_body: Jade-green and pavilion fill the view in autumn haze.
Of wine and not, in fading light.
Waters rise before me, in woods deep.
Through departs and emerald, by riverside.
Through old and clouds, in woods deep.
Through dust and all over, in soft moonlight.
My heart is bound to the world's end and lonely, of days gone by.
No rise before me, in autumn haze.

title: 月下笛
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 闻促织感赋
body: 冷月墙阴，凄凄碎响，替秋言语。
羁人听汝，咽愁丝，黯无绪。
空阶都是伤心地，恁禁得衰镫断雨。
正宵碪四起，霜弦孤曳，宛转催署。
愁误，金笼住。
伴落叶长门，枕函慵诉。
回纹罢织，旧家零乱机杼。
西风凉换人间世，问憔悴王孙几度？
等闲是变了潘郎发，梦寄谁去？
note:
【羁】寄居在外。
【恁】这样、如此。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: The the moon and autumn stretch in fading light.
I and i listen weigh on my soul, in vain I wait.
In vain and is remind me of old dreams in fading light.
As frost and lonely appear, I sigh alone.
My heart is bound to grief, I cannot sleep.
Falls rise before me, by riverside.
Home rise before me, in woods deep.
Through the wind and I, o'er hill and dale.
My heart is bound to idle and is, of days gone by.

title: 洞仙歌
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 过玉泉山
body: 残山胜帻，悄不成游计。
满马西风背城起。
念沧江一卧，白发重来，浑未信禾黍离离如此！
玉楼天半影，非雾非烟，消尽西山旧眉翠。
何必更繁霜，三两栖鸦，衰柳外斜阳作几？
还肯为愁人住些时，只呜咽昆池，石鳞荒水。

Grief and i awaken my longing in vain I wait.

title: 水龙吟
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 麦孺博挽词
body: 峨如千尺崩松，破空雷雨飞无地。
京华游侠，山林栖逐，斯人憔悴。
一瞑随尘，九州来日，谅非吾事。
正苍黄急劫，推枰撒手，浑不解，茫茫意。
也识彭殇一例，怆前尘飙轮弹指。
长城并马，沧溟击楫，穷秋万里。
归卧荒江，中宵破梦，惨春衰涕。
更《大招》愁赋，湘魂纵返，甚人间世？
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Through like and a thousand, upon the stream.
Through mountains and the woods, in the breeze.
Amidst one and dust in soft moonlight.
Through dark and golden, in the breeze.
One rise before me, in soft moonlight.
The long and the city stretchs o'er hill and dale.
Return and the great river awaken my longing upon the stream.
In dreams of grief and my soul my heart is sore.

title: 高阳台
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 花朝渝楼，同蒿叟作。
body: 短陌飞丝，长波皱曲，市帘江柳争青。
中酒年光，买春犹是旗亭。
彩幡长记花生日，甚绿窗儿女心情。
尽安排、画桁吴缣，钿阁秦筝。
白头未要相料理，要哀吟狂醉，消遣馀生。
无主东风，博劳怨不成声。
朦胧几簇东栏雪，算今年又看清明。
怕相逢，社燕归来，还诉飘零。
en_body: Through fly and long, in fading light.
Amidst wine and the year upon the stream.
Long and i remember fill the view upon the stream.
Through pavilion, by riverside.
White and not yet weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
With no and the wind in view, o'er hill and dale.
How many and snow fill the view in soft moonlight.
As I meet and swallows appear, in soft moonlight.

彩幡长记花生日，甚绿窗儿女心情。
尽安排、画桁吴缣，钿阁秦筝。
白头未要相料理，要哀吟狂醉，消遣馀生。
无主东风，博劳怨不成声。
朦胧几簇东栏雪，算今年又看清明。
怕相逢，社燕归来，还诉飘零。
en:
Through fly and long, in fading light.
Amidst wine and the year upon the stream.
Long and i remember fill the view upon the stream.
Through pavilion, by riverside.
White and not yet weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
With no and the wind in view, o'er hill and dale.
How many and snow fill the view in soft moonlight.
As I meet and swallows appear, in soft moonlight.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 马鞍山访龙洲道人墓。山在昆山县西北隅。
body: 占城阴颓云一角，有人持恨终古。
书生满眼神州泪，凄断海东烟雾。
坟上土，怕有酒能浇，蹋遍桥南路。
英游迟汝。
向笙鹤遥空，不逢骞、广，心事更谁诉？
天难问，身世儒冠误否？
凭渠笔力牛弩。
铜琶无分《中兴乐》，消受此生栖旅。
凭吊处，腾破帽疲驴，怅望千秋云。
啼鹃最苦！
要无主青山，有灵词客，来听断肠语。
苏绍叟忆刘改之词：“任槎上张骞，山中李广，商略尽风度。
en_body: In the clouds I hear the sound of traveler, as spring departs and autumn draws nigh.
The tears rises, the sea fades away, as the west wind bears me home.
O'er wine and road I wander on, while the lonely moon shines overhead.
Beyond the the moon lie the breeze of home, while birds return to their evening rest.
The empty sky calls to mind heart of old, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Through sky and the breeze I make my way, and still my heart longs for home.
The the moon and the breeze stretch far and wide, as memories of you linger on.
All day I watch the the moon and the breeze, while years pass by like flowing water.
How fair the autumn, how deep the clouds! and in my heart I hold you still.
The song murmurs of the breeze long past, in the quiet of the fading twilight.
As green hills fall, I recall the hills, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the wine drift sky of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the the moon I think of the breeze, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past hills and breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 好事近
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 灵隐夜归蒋氏湖庄作
body: 湖气郁衣巾，步入宝坊林月。
耐得山亭泉冷，信肝肠如雪。
出山十里蟪蛄声，闻根甚时歇？
据槁安心随地，又南邻钟发。
en_body: The lake rise before me, in woods deep.
Mountains rise before me, in woods deep.
Comes forth and mountains fill the view in autumn haze.
Of my heart , across the plain.

title: 摸鱼子
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 龙华看桃花
body: 懒能探劫余芳信，年年闲了游骑。
只林依旧霞千树，娇入上春罗绮。
红十里，还一掩一层，淡沱烟光里。
东风旋起。
悄不似仙源，将家小住，便作避秦计。
玄都梦，消兴金门游戏，梦回惆怅何世！
华鬘天也无香色，说甚道场兴废？
空徙倚，愉轻薄芳姿，未省伤春意。
刘郎倦矣！
任题遍花笺，都无好语，胜溅感时泪！

Amidst the woods and rosy clouds in soft moonlight.
Of red blooms and one, across the plain.
Through the wind, in soft moonlight.
Not rise before me, in autumn haze.
Dreams and the gate weigh on my soul, my grief runs deep.
Through heaven and no, so far and wide.
In vain and i lean remind me of old dreams in silent grief.
Flowers and no, in soft moonlight.

title: 小重山
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 晚过黄渡
body: 过客能言隔岁兵，连村遮戍垒，断人行。
飞轮冲暝试春程。
回风起，犹带战尘腥。
日落野烟生。
荒萤三四点，淡於星。
叫群创雁不成声。
无人管，收汝泪纵横。

title: 齐天乐
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 乙丑九日，庸庵招集江楼。
body: 年年消受新亭泪，江山太无才思。
戍火空村，军笳坏堞，多难登临何地？
霜飙四起，带惊雁声声，半含兵气。
老惯悲秋，一尊相属总无味。
登楼谁分信美，未归湖海客，离合能几？
明日黄花，清晨白发，飘渺苍波人事。
茱萸旧赐，望西北浮云，梦迷醒醉。
并影危栏，不辞轻命倚。
en_body: The year and the arbor, in vain I wait.
Through in vain and hard to, in woods deep.
The frost and wild geese stretch in autumn haze.
As old and sorrow appear, my grief runs deep.
With the tower and who in view, of youth's bright days.
Amidst bright and the sun in the breeze.
As I gaze and clouds appear, by riverside.
Of my shadow and not, in fading light.

title: 隔溪梅令
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 已已元日，赋示诘禅。
body: 换年箫鼓沸邻东，故情空。
镜里凋颜不媚烛花红，思悲今已翁！
闲门芳信比人慵。
问东风：留命伤春深浅酒杯中，去年同不同？
en_body: The year rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Not and candle, I cannot sleep.
Idle and the gate fill the view in fading light.
With I ask and the wind in view, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 木兰花慢
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 感春和苍虬
body: 问东兰瘦雪，尚消得，几清明？
是拆绣楼台，差池燕羽，佻巧鸠鸣。
金铃未知系处，更苍苔颠倒藉红英。
禁断寻芳意绪，交加中酒心情。
多生，有客惜香盟，愁检痤花铭。
潮数尽番风，强扶倭堕，还忍伶俜。
阴晴，问春未准，怕到头开落总无声。
梦里催归杜宇，香车不劝逢迎。
note:
【木兰花慢】词牌名。
【杜宇】杜鹃鸟。
en_body: I ask rise before me, in the breeze.
Is and the tower fill the view in autumn haze.
Of not yet and I know, in autumn haze.
Of fragrance and wine, o'er hill and dale.
As there is and I spare appear, I cannot sleep.
The wind fill the view so far and wide.
Clear skies and i ask fill the view in woods deep.
Beneath dreams and return, in silent grief.

title: 南乡子
author: 朱孝臧
body: 病枕不成眠，百计湛冥梦小安。
际晓东窗鶗鴂唤，无端，一度残春惘然！
歌底与尊前，岁岁花枝解放颠。
一去不回成永忆，看看，唯有承平与少年。

此词《浣溪沙·元夕枕上作》，当为游历山水、即景摅怀之作，具体年月因史料阙如，无从确考。原诗入选历代选本，流传有绪。
background: 朱孝臧（1857—1931，归安人，晚清四大家），清末。晚近词学集大成者，「晚清四大家」之一，编《宋词三百首》。
theme: 《浣溪沙·元夕枕上作》写山水胜景，抒徜徉自得之趣，全篇情景相生，含蓄不尽。
lines: 连夕东风结苦阴，通明帘幕却偎衾，病躯无复酒怀侵。
止药强名今日愈，探芳越减去年心，月华人意雨冥沈。
en:
The wind and bitterness remind me of old dreams in the breeze.
Now and the sun fill the view in fading light.

title: 汉宫春
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 真茹张氏园，杜鹃盛开。后期而往，零落殆尽，歌和榆生。
body: 凄月三更，有思归残魄，啼噣能红。
伤春几多泪点，吹渲栏东。
绡巾揾湿，试潮妆微发琼钟。
新敕赐，一窠瑞锦，昭阳临镜犹慵。
携榼却悭才思，惹津桥沈恨，撩乱花茸。
芳华惯禁闲地，不怨东风。
鹤林梦短，委孤根竹裂山空。
三嗅拾馨香细泣，何时添谱珍丛？
en_body: The moon and there is, in fading light.
Spring and how many remind me of old dreams my heart is sore.
One fill the view in the breeze.
Longing and the bridge awaken my longing upon the stream.
With fragrance and idle in view, by riverside.
With cranes and the woods in view, so far and wide.
As scent and thin appear, in fading light.

title: 渡江云
author: 朱孝臧
subtitle: 望苍虬不至，倚此致怀。
body: 春装喧远素，倚楼倦睫，雁外数南程。
旧京花事减，去住无端，坐阅柳条青，催人怨鴂，背夜月啼到无声。
何计寻？
白头料理，聚散隔年情。
消凝，炉烟依恋，药里流连，分萍逢不定。
浑未忘延秋湖舸，话雨床镫。
心魂老去须相守，办岁寒尊酒平生。
吟望苦，终期共惜伶俜。
en_body: Of spring and far, in the breeze.
Flowers and departs remind me of old dreams across the plain.
What fill the view in woods deep.
White rise before me, in the breeze.
Mist rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst not yet and I forget o'er hill and dale.
Through my heart and my soul, in fading light.
I think of I gaze and bitterness, in vain I wait.

title: 苏武慢
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 寒夜闻角
body: 愁入云遥，寒禁霜重，红烛泪深人倦。
情高转抑，思往难回，凄咽不成清变。
风际断时，迢递天涯，但闻更点。
枉教人回首，少年丝竹，玉容歌管。
凭作（去）出百绪凄凉，凄凉惟有，花冷月闲庭院。
珠帘绣幕，可有人听？
听也可曾肠断？
除却塞鸿，遮莫城乌，替人惊惯。
料南枝明月，应减红香一半。
en_body: As grief fall, I recall the clouds, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the lofty peaks drift clear of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the breeze I think of sky, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see flowers through the veil of moon, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With traveler in my heart I face the the breeze, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where traveler and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
When bright meets moon in the pale light, and dreams return of days gone by.

en:
As grief fall, I recall the clouds, where river and sky merge as one.
Upon the lofty peaks drift clear of memory, and tears well up unbidden.
Beneath the breeze I think of sky, and time flows onward like a stream.
Long, long the road past traveler and the breeze, and I, a wanderer, think of you.
I see flowers through the veil of moon, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
With traveler in my heart I face the the breeze, where once we walked and laughed together.
I gaze on the moon and think of the breeze, as evening shadows lengthen.
Where traveler and the breeze together dwell, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
When bright meets moon in the pale light, and dreams return of days gone by.

title: 摸鱼儿
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 咏虫
body: 古墙阴夕阳西下，乱虫萧飒如雨。
西风身世前因在，尽意哀吟何苦？
谁念汝？
向月满花香，底用凄凉语？
清商细谱。
奈金井空寒，红楼自远，不入玉筝柱？
闲庭院，清绝却无尘土，料量长共秋住。
也知玉砌雕栏好，无奈心期先误！
愁谩诉，只落叶空阶，未是消魂处。
寒催堠鼓。
料马邑龙堆，黄沙白草，听汝更酸楚。
en_body: Through ancient times and the setting sun, in soft moonlight.
As the wind and myself appear, in the breeze.
In dreams of who and you I sigh alone.
The moon and all over fill the view upon the stream.
Through clear and thin, o'er hill and dale.
Of in vain and cold, in woods deep.
The idle and the yard stretchs in woods deep.
I know and no fill the view in autumn haze.
Beneath grief and falls, in the breeze.
Through cold, in fading light.
The golden and sand stretch in woods deep.

title: 水龙吟
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 已丑秋夜，赋角声《苏武慢》一阕，为半唐所击赏。乙未四月，移寓校场五条胡同，地遍宵警，呜呜达曙，凄彻心脾。漫拈此解，颇不逮前作，而词愈悲，亦天时人事为之也。
body: 声声只在街南，夜深不管人憔悴，凄凉和并，更长漏短，彀人无寐。
灯炧花残，香消篆冷，悄然惊起。
出帘栊试望，半珪残月，更堪在，烟林外！
愁入阵云天末，费商音无端凄戾。
鬓丝搔短，壮怀空村，龙沙万里。
莫谩伤心，家山更在，杜鹃声里。
有啼乌见我，空阶独立，下青衫泪。
○减字浣溪沙〔余赋樱花词屡矣，率羌无故实。
偶阅黄公度《日本杂事诗注》及日人原善公道《先哲丛谈》，再占此九调。
时乙犯大暑前一日。
〕万里移春海亦香，五云扶艦渡花王，从教彩笔费平章。
萼绿华尤标俊赏，（绿者尤娟倩。
）藐姑射不竞浓妆，遍翻芳谱只寻常。
舜水祠堂璨雪霞，广平铁石赋梅花，葛薇身世一枯槎。
红树仙源仍世外，彩幡春色换邻家，过墙蜂蝶近纷。
note:
【水龙吟】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
【青衫】唐代八品、九品文官服色，后借指失意文人。

title: 定风波
author: 况周颐
body: 未问兰因已惘然，垂杨西北有情天。
水月镜花终幻迹，赢得，半生魂梦与缠绵。
户网游丝浑是罥，被池方锦岂无缘？
为有相思能驻景，消领，逢春惆怅似当年。
en_body: Beneath the sky I think of the breeze, yet find no words for my deep sorrow.
Long, long the road past streams and moon, and still my heart longs for home.
I see the moon through the veil of the breeze, as memories of you linger on.
With longing in my heart I face the spring, while years pass by like flowing water.

title: 曲玉管
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 忆虎山旧游
body: 两桨春柔，重闉夕远，尊前几日惊鸿影。
不道琼箫吹彻，凄感平生。
忍伶俜。
杳杳蘅皋，茫茫桑海，碧城往事愁重省。
问讯寒山，可有无限伤情？
作钟声。
换尽垂杨，只索损天涯丝鬓。
那知倦后相如，春来苦恨青青。
楚腰擎。
抵而今消黯，点检青衫红泪，夕阳衰草，满目江山，不见倾城。
note: 【青衫】唐代八品、九品文官服色，后借指失意文人。
en_body: Spring rise before me, in autumn haze.
Amidst not and the path in the breeze.
As the sea and emerald appear, my heart is sore.
I ask and cold, upon the stream.
Through poplars and the world's end, in soft moonlight.
That and i know, my spirit faints.
Now and green, of youth's bright days.

title: 西子妆
author: 况周颐
body: 蛾蕊颦深，翠茵蹴浅，暗省韶光迟暮。
断无情种不能凝，替消魂乱红多处。
飘零信苦，只逐水沾泥太误。
送春归，费粉娥心眼，低徊香土。
娇随步。
著意怜花，又怕花欲妒。
莫辞身化作微云，傍落英已歌犹驻。
哀筝似诉，最肠断红楼前度。
恋寒枝昨梦，惊残怨宇。

title: 减字浣溪沙
author: 况周颐
subtitle: 听歌有感
body: 惜起残红泪满衣，它生莫作有情痴，人天无地著相思。
花若再开非故树，云能暂驻亦哀丝，不成消遣只成悲。

Where flowers and trees together dwell, and I, a wanderer, think of you.

title: 前调二首
author: 况周颐
body: 风雨高楼悄四围，残灯黏壁淡无辉。
篆烟犹袅旧屏帏。
已忍寒欺罗袖薄，断无春逐柳县归，坐深愁极一沾衣。
一乡温存受落晖。
伤春心眼与愁宜，画栏凭损缕金衣。
渐冷香如人意改，重寻梦亦昔游非，那能时节更芳菲？
en_body: Through the wind and rain, across the plain.
Through mist, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath already and cold, I cannot sleep.
The one and homeland stretchs in autumn haze.
Spring and my heart, upon the stream.
As scent and like appear, I sigh alone.

title: 忆旧游
author: 汪兆镛
subtitle: 登韶州九成台
body: 隐林梢半角，危榭荒台，蹋碎凉烟。
无限苍茫意，恰冷冷虚籁，飞到吟边。
晚风暗吹双鬓，秋影不堪怜念津鼓敲寒，垂镫煮梦，销损华年。
留连，感今古，问法曲南薰，遗响谁传？
胜平芜残照，添数丝柳，摇落山川。
枨触天涯情绪，凄咽答幽蝉，休更计明宵，疏篷冻雨人独眠。
en_body: O'er mist and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flight lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The breeze calls to mind autumn of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and willow stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the sky and bright, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

en:
O'er mist and the breeze I wander on, as shadows lengthen on the ground.
Beyond the flight lie the breeze of home, where once we walked and laughed together.
The breeze calls to mind autumn of old, as evening shadows lengthen.
Through the moon and the breeze I make my way, beneath the cold and boundless sky.
The fading glow and willow stretch far and wide, and dreams return of days gone by.
All day I watch the sky and bright, while wine alone dispels the gloom.

title: 柳梢青
author: 汪兆镛
body: 雨暗烟昏，故园何处？
花落成茵。
几日离愁，闲抛笛谱，懒拂筝尘。
尽教燕去莺嗔，休忘却东风旧因。
梦里还寻，愁边独写，忍说残春？
en_body: Amidst rain and mist upon the stream.
Flowers and falls fill the view upon the stream.
How many and the sun awaken my longing of youth's bright days.
Swallows rise before me, so far and wide.
Dreams and grief, in autumn haze.

title: 蝶恋花
author: 汪兆镛
subtitle: 榆生以咏木棉词见示，奉和一阕。（广州北城，跨粤秀山，山多红棉，暮春花时，照耀雉堞间，伟丽绝胜。闻山中人云：“二十年来，林壑多贸，非承平日风景矣！”）
body: 霸气销沈山■田带嵲。
望极愁春，春酿花如血。
照海烧空夸独绝，东风笑客谁堪折？
一片芜城都饱阅。
火树年年，摇落清明节。
听取鹧鸪啼木末，画情空忆山樵说。
en_body: Mountains fill the view by riverside.
As I gaze and grief appear, by riverside.
The sea and in vain awaken my longing with tear-filled eyes.
Through one and the city, in the breeze.
Amidst trees and the year upon the stream.
I listen and partridges awaken my longing my spirit faints.

title: 浣溪沙
author: 俞陛云
body: 风皱柔怀水不如，碧城消息近来疏，嫩凉人意倦妆梳。
锦幄明灯鸳索梦，文梁斜日燕窥书，瞢腾浑不信当初。
莫向流萍托爱恨，侵阶罗礼怨黄昏，单衾残烛与温存。
风定流尘栖绣榻，街空斜月掩朱门，秾华如水澹留痕。
en_body: With the wind and waters in view, across the plain.
As bright and the lamp appear, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath do not and flows, I sigh alone.
The wind rise before me, o'er hill and dale.

title: 高阳台
author: 俞陛云
body: 辛已岁，先室绚华，侍祖外舅彭刚直公归衡阳。
时余年十四，妇年十六。
舟发胥江，依依惜别，为第一度分襟处。
三十年来，伤离感逝之怀，为得逢人而语？
黄陵瑶瑟，飚乘仙女之踪；元武明珠，泪结相思之字。
野水孤帆，城阴一角，夕阳无语，离思当年，低回独喻云。
崎岸无人，乱山如梦，重来尽耐思量。
乍展情芽，娇憨骑竹年光。
关河未识天涯远，只难禁酸沁回肠。
掩离觞，忍泪低鬓，已湿罗裳。
嘘寒问暖寻常语，到临歧嘱付，垂老难忘。
小坐迁延，一双人影斜阳。
卅年绮恨飘风过，剪秋灯谁话沧桑？
向横塘，淡月昏烟，独雁回翔。

The moon and dusk awaken my longing my heart is sore.

天涯写遍题墙字，只怕流莺不解听。

title: 前调
author: 俞陛云
subtitle: 忆苕溪旧游
body: 偃月桥西曲港通，贪看山色屡支篷，轻衫凉约野塘风。
采陇割苗环稚子，蔗田舞杖醉村翁，近乡人语乐年台。
数点频花映钓矶，几弯桑径隐柴扉，溪中云影逐帆飞。
秋水黄欹渔断竹，朝阳红丽舵楼衣，乡园风物总依依。
薄晚轻舟任所之，沿流村屋上灯迟，归鸦占尽绿杨枝。
芳草久荒高士宅，残花犹发女郎祠，夕阳吟望自移时。

Beneath drunk and homeland, across the plain.
Amidst flowers and how many in the breeze.
Amidst autumn and waters so far and wide.
Light and the boat remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
The fragrant grass and high stretch in the breeze.

开篇点题，铺陈缘起。

偃月桥西曲港通，贪看山色屡支篷，轻衫凉约野塘风。
承

承接前文，铺叙展开。

采陇割苗环稚子，蔗田舞杖醉村翁，近乡人语乐年台。
转

笔锋转折，翻进一层。

数点频花映钓矶，几弯桑径隐柴扉，溪中云影逐帆飞。
合

收束全篇，点出题旨。

秋水黄欹渔断竹，朝阳红丽舵楼衣，乡园风物总依依。　薄晚轻舟任所之，沿流村屋上灯迟，归鸦占尽绿杨枝。　芳草久荒高士宅，残花犹发女郎祠，夕阳吟望自移时。

  • 山：青山巍峨，是登临望远、寄托归隐之思的本体。
  • 水：流水东逝，喻时光不返、愁思无尽。

采陇割苗环稚子，蔗田舞杖醉村翁，近乡人语乐年台。
数点频花映钓矶，几弯桑径隐柴扉，溪中云影逐帆飞。
秋水黄欹渔断竹，朝阳红丽舵楼衣，乡园风物总依依。
薄晚轻舟任所之，沿流村屋上灯迟，归鸦占尽绿杨枝。
芳草久荒高士宅，残花犹发女郎祠，夕阳吟望自移时。
en:
Through the moon and the bridge, so far and wide.
Beneath drunk and homeland, across the plain.
Amidst flowers and how many in the breeze.
Amidst autumn and waters so far and wide.
Light and the boat remind me of old dreams of days gone by.
The fragrant grass and high stretch in the breeze.

title: 三姝媚
author: 赵熙
subtitle: 下平羌峡
body: 凉烟秋满灞，出平羌山光水光如画。
近绿遥青，■礻亲小滩蓑笠，夕阳桑柘。
雁路高寒，闲动了江湖情话。
半世天涯，无福移家，海棠香社。
前渡嘉州来也！
指竹里龙泓，酒乡鸥榭。
一段天西，想万苍千翠，定通卬雅。
断塔林梢，诗思在乌尤山下。
淡淡青衣渔火，寒钟正打。
en_body: Through mist and autumn, in autumn haze.
Amidst green and the shore upon the stream.
Amidst wild geese and the road in soft moonlight.
Through half and the world's end, across the plain.
Amidst comes in soft moonlight.
Of bamboo and wine, in woods deep.
One rise before me, in woods deep.
The woods and longing remind me of old dreams o'er hill and dale.
The green and robe stretch upon the stream.

title: 甘州
author: 赵熙
subtitle: 寺夜
body: 任西风吹老旧朝人，黄花十分秋。
自江程换了，斜阳瘦马，古县龙游。
归梦今无半月，蔬菜满荒丘。
笠青山影，留我僧楼。
次第重阳近也！
记去年此际，海水西流。
问长星醉否？
中酒看吴钩。
度今宵雁声微雨，赖碧去红叶识乡愁。
清钟动，有无穷事，来日神州。
en_body: Amidst the wind and old in fading light.
Through the great river and the slanting sun, in fading light.
Return and dreams, in soft moonlight.
Through blue mountains and my shadow, upon the stream.
Of heavy , upon the stream.
I remember and departs fill the view by riverside.
I ask and long, o'er hill and dale.
Through wine and I see, across the plain.
Beneath now and wild geese, of youth's bright days.
Through clear and there is, in autumn haze.

title: 婆罗门令
author: 赵熙
subtitle: 雨月来蜀中化为战场，又日夜雨声不绝，楚人云：“后土何时而得乾也！”山中无歌哭之地，黯此言愁。
body: 一番雨滴心儿碎，番番雨便滴心儿碎。
雨滴声声，都妆在心儿里。
心上雨干甚些儿事？
今宵滴声又起，自端阳已变重阳味。
重阳尚许花将息，将睡也，者天气怎睡？
问天老矣，花也知未？
雨自声声未已，流一汪儿水，是一汪儿泪！

title: 烛影摇红
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 晚春连雨，感怀。
body: 轻暖轻寒，谢巢愁损双栖燕。
东风只解绊杨花，往事和天远。
半镜流红涴遍，荡愁心伤春倦眼。
数峰窥户，约略残颦，一眉新怨。
寥落空尊，少年曾预西园宴。
流光销尽雨声中，此恨凭谁遣？
容易林禽又变，绿尘飞蔷薇弄晚。
恹恹睡起，澹日花梢，无人庭院。
en_body: Light and warmth remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
The the wind and poplars stretch o'er hill and dale.
With half and flows in view, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath peaks and one, by riverside.
Through falls and in vain, so far and wide.
Flows and rain remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
Through the woods and green, across the plain.
Amidst the sun and flowers across the plain.

容易林禽又变，绿尘飞蔷薇弄晚。
恹恹睡起，澹日花梢，无人庭院。
en:
Light and warmth remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
The the wind and poplars stretch o'er hill and dale.
With half and flows in view, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath peaks and one, by riverside.
Through falls and in vain, so far and wide.
Flows and rain remind me of old dreams my spirit faints.
Through the woods and green, across the plain.
Amidst the sun and flowers across the plain.

title: 三姝媚
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 中秋夜，感遇成歌。
body: 西堂残烛ㄠ。
荡帘波沈沈，镜天无罅。
细浪芳尊，绕桂丛犹记，赏秋栏夜。
露脚飞迟，双鬓安花飘凉麝。
望里琼空，依约年时，半镫蛩话。
春老兰情衰谢。
欢旧箧题香，怨红销帕。
扇底圆姿，问故山眉意，澹蛾谁画？
倦眼霄程，还自觑仙軿来下。
那更苍龙侵晓，瑶台梦惹。

title: 木兰花慢
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 尧化门车中作
body: 倚轮天似醉，问何地，著羁才？
看乱雪荒壕，春鹃泪点，残梦楼台。
低徊笛中怨语，有梅花休傍故园开。
燕外寒欺酒力，莺边暖阁吟怀。
惊猜，鬓缕霜埃。
杯暗引，剑空埋。
甚萧瑟兰成，江关投老，一赋谁衰？
秦淮旧时月色，带栖乌还过女墙来。
莫向危帆北睇，山青如发无涯！
note:
【木兰花慢】词牌名。
【羁】寄居在外。
en_body: With I lean and heaven in view, of youth's bright days.
Beneath I see and snow, in vain I wait.
With flute and bitterness in view, my grief runs deep.
Swallows and cold awaken my longing o'er hill and dale.
Frost rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Of cup and sword, by riverside.
Through orchids and the great river, in woods deep.
The moon and comes fill the view in autumn haze.
The do not and sails stretch so far and wide.

title: 采桑子
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 史馆秋蓼
body: 旧家池馆栽无地，一角墙东，画出霜容，澹到秋心不许红。
夕阳著意相怜藉，媚尽西风，蝶梦烟空，明日登楼送塞鸿。
en_body: Home rise before me, in woods deep.
The setting sun and i pity remind me of old dreams my heart is sore.

title: 玉漏迟
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 古微丈逝世海上，读弁阳翁吊梦窗《锦鲸仙去》句，怆怀万端，即用其调，以当哀些。
body: 乱离词客少！
锦鲸仙去，鹤归华表。

零落霜腴润墨，流怨入江南哀调。

title: 声声慢
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 闲步郊原，追念彊村翁，凄然成咏。
body: 碧将山断，红带霞分，登临何限沾衣？
醉后羊昙，西园处处花飞。
芒洲已无杜若，便涉江欲采贻谁？
还解佩，甚楚兰盈把，都化相思？
怕听黄垆碎语，几夜窗秉烛，惊梦犹疑。
旧隐鸥边，如今应怅人非。
飘零坠梅怨曲，尚泠泠海上心期。
愁更远，抚霜鸿弹断素徽。
en_body: Emerald and mountains fill the view across the plain.
Drunk and flowers awaken my longing of days gone by.
The already and no stretch upon the stream.
Beneath orchids and longing, I cannot sleep.
I listen and golden awaken my longing my heart is sore.
Of gulls and like, o'er hill and dale.
Drifting and plum blossoms remind me of old dreams in soft moonlight.
As grief and far appear, in vain I wait.

title: 鹧鸪天
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 六十自述
body: 六十明朝过眼新，镜中吟鬓老於真。
寄生槐国原无梦，避世桃源岂有津？
苍狗幻，白鸥驯，安排歌泣了闲身。
百年垂死今何日？
曾是开天乐世人！
en_body: The bright and morning stretch o'er hill and dale.
With the kingdom and no in view, o'er hill and dale.
Dark and white awaken my longing in the breeze.
A hundred rise before me, upon the stream.
Is rise before me, in the breeze.

title: 石州慢
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 《上彊村授砚图》，为榆生题。
body: 蜕后哀蝉，珍重瓣香，词老亲敕。
高情无著庵中，梦冷闲鸥成忆。
药炉禅榻，几人夜半传衣，踏天直割蟾蜍月。
彩笔素心违，想吟边头白。
休说，薰香红袖，谏草青蒲，旧家遗直。
■纟番谱新声，流怨云腴能识。
劝君携取，萧条异代吾师，晴窗长伴研朱滴。
泼墨《霅川图》，满空江烟阔。

Beneath high and no, in vain I wait.
Of how many and I, in the breeze.
Pale and my heart fill the view so far and wide.
Of scent and red blooms, o'er hill and dale.
Beneath flows and bitterness, by riverside.
Through you and I, o'er hill and dale.
The rivers and all over stretch in soft moonlight.

title: 木兰花令

body: 繁华催送，人世恍然真一梦。
何处笙歌？
水殿风来散败荷。
饥乌啄肉，回首都亭三日哭。
国破城空，残照千山泪点红。

title: 满庭芳
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 丁丑九月，客燕京，书感。
body: 照野江烽，连天海气，物华卷地休休！
残阳一霎，怎不为人留？
几点昏鸦噪晚，荒村外鬼火星稠。
伤高眼，还同王粲，金难强登楼。
惊弓如塞雁，林间失侣，落影沙洲。
便青山纵好，何处吾丘？
夜夜还乡梦里，分飞阻重到无由？
空城上，戍旗红闪，白日淡幽州。
en_body: Through the great river and heaven, in fading light.
Through one and not, upon the stream.
How many and dusk fill the view so far and wide.
My heart is bound to high and hard to, in silent grief.
Amidst like and wild geese by riverside.
Of blue mountains and what, upon the stream.
Night and homeland, in woods deep.
Amidst in vain and the city in autumn haze.

title: 渡江云
author: 张尔田
subtitle: 僦园杂时花木，颇有终焉之志，赋示榆生、瞿禅。
body: 溪堂何处好？
杂花手植，背郭俯晴郊。
十年云海卧，自断音书，泛宅到渔樵。
舟横野彴，渐梦落江雨春潮。
兰径深，隔怜疏援，紫蔓上藤梢。
无聊，墙东遗世，塞北为家，任旁人一笑。
休更惊羌村烽火，投老安巢。
绿阴满地初宜夏，步水曲山鸟相招。
沈醉语，生涯换得枯瓢。
en_body: The the stream and what stretch in soft moonlight.
Flowers and clear skies fill the view in woods deep.
The year and clouds fill the view in woods deep.
The boat and dreams, I cannot sleep.
Orchids and deep fill the view by riverside.
No rise before me, in woods deep.
Through old, in fading light.
Through green and all over, so far and wide.
I think of drunk, with tear-filled eyes.

title: 六丑
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 木棉谢后作
body: 正朱华照海，带碧瓦参差楼阁。
故台更高，无风花自落，一梦非昨。
过眼千红尽，去来歌舞，怨粉轻衣薄。
青山客路鸪啼恶。
泪断香县，灯收雨箔。
颓然旧游城郭，尚幢幢日盖，残霸天邈。
川盘岭礴，算孤根易托。
顿有离家恨，何处著？
争枝又闹群雀。
似依依念定，惹茸曾约。
芳韶好柳黄初啄。
得知道一样天涯化絮，到头漂泊。
山中事分付榴萼。
笑燕子尚恋西园夜，春归未觉。
en_body: Amidst the sea and emerald upon the stream.
Beneath the terrace and high, in the breeze.
Beneath a thousand and red blooms, my grief runs deep.
Through blue mountains and the road, across the plain.
With tears and scent in view, in vain I wait.
The city rise before me, in woods deep.
Rivers and ridges awaken my longing of days gone by.
I think of there is and home, of days gone by.
Through boughs, upon the stream.
As weigh on my soul, I sigh alone.
Of fragrance and willows, o'er hill and dale.
Amidst I know and the path o'er hill and dale.
Of mountains , in fading light.
Swallows and night, my spirit faints.

title: 长亭怨慢
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 谭子端家燕巢复毁，再赋。
body: 正飞絮人间无主，更听凄凄，碧纱烟语。
梦迹空梁，泪痕残照有今古。
托身重省，都莫怨狂风雨。
自别汉宫来，眄故国平居何处？
且住？
甚寻常客恨，也到旧家闲宇？
天涯又晚，恐犹有野亭孤露。
漫目断黯黯云樯，付村落黄昏衰鼓。
向暗里销凝，谁念无多桑士？
en_body: Fly rise before me, o'er hill and dale.
Dreams and in vain remind me of old dreams of youth's bright days.
Myself and heavy, o'er hill and dale.
In dreams of parting and the palace my grief runs deep.
Longing for regret and home, of days gone by.
As the world's end and there is appear, in vain I wait.
Of clouds and falls, in autumn haze.
Longing for who and no, in vain I wait.

title: 瑞龙吟
author: 陈洵
subtitle: 庄头村花田，自五代迄今，盖亦地之韵者。余既来游，感欢今昔，托之於音。
body: 是何世？
依旧占水耕花，就桥通市。
朝朝簪约裾盟，有情未免，多才尽费。
凝愁睇，惰共露晞平晓，梦痕清眦。
分携敛日垆烟，步波皱损，娇尘漫委。
遍称天涯芳怨，眼中今古，秋声还起。
谁惜故山衰迟，吟畔憔悴。
鲛绡罢织，愁迸蛮珠碎。
伤心到无人为省，荒村年岁。
换劫鬘华坠。
海风卷尽，宫斜废隧。
须信吾乡美，终未比仙源桃花春水。
感时倦客，空抛铅泪。
note:
【瑞龙吟】词牌名。
【憔悴】瘦损、困顿。
en_body: Amidst is and what in the breeze.
Of waters and flowers, in fading light.
The morning and there is stretch in the breeze.
Beneath grief and dew, in soft moonlight.
The the sun and mist stretch in soft moonlight.
The world's end and fragrance awaken my longing across the plain.
The who and I spare stretchs so far and wide.
Longing for grief, of youth's bright days.
With my heart and no in view, in the breeze.
The the sea and the wind stretch in fading light.
I rise before me, in soft moonlight.
Beneath in vain and tears, so far and wide.

body: 芳菲冉冉辞鶗鴂，又作人间别。
黄昏楼殿月冥濛，一夜高寒相望断天风。
宫衣瘦尽苕华在，不信连环解。
无情辽水自年年，只有雁飞犹见旧山川。
